A discrete T-cell cluster coexpresses CD3 and CD2 with normal intensity, and a few CD2-positive, CD3-negative NK cells are present. There is no evidence of an aberrant T-cell population with pan-T antigen loss. Findings indicate relatively reduced but phenotypically normal T cells, consistent with a background to chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: T-cell lymphoma with pan-T antigen loss
ddx.vs: Neoplastic T cells show loss or dim expression of CD2, CD3, CD5, or CD7, unlike the uniformly bright CD3/CD2 T cells here.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell expansions show a large CD2-positive/CD3-negative population, whereas NK cells here are sparse.
T-LGL expands a CD3-positive/CD8-positive/CD57-positive population often with dim CD5 or CD7, rather than a small normal T-cell cluster.

62445.recognize_zh: 高倍下大腸腺窩之間的固有層充滿帶亮橘紅色粗顆粒、雙葉核的嗜酸性球，部分嗜酸性球已進入腺窩上皮；此圖本身主要呈現嗜酸性球浸潤，肥大細胞在 H&E 上不易辨認，需搭配 CD117/CD25 才能支持肥大細胞增生症。
features: Lamina propria between crypts densely infiltrated by eosinophils with bright orange-red coarse granules and bilobed nuclei
Focal intraepithelial eosinophils within crypt epithelium
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasma cells and a few pale oval mononuclear cells
Crypts retain goblet cells without architectural distortion or crypt abscesses
Neoplastic mast cells are not reliably distinguishable on H&E at this magnification
62445.describe_en: High-power view of colonic mucosa (H&E) shows a lamina propria densely infiltrated by eosinophils, with focal extension of eosinophils into the crypt epithelium. Admixed lymphocytes, plasma cells and occasional pale oval mononuclear cells are present, while crypts remain intact without distortion or crypt abscesses. The eosinophil-rich infiltrate is nonspecific on its own; spindled mast cells are not clearly discernible in this field. Findings are compatible with the eosinophil-rich component of mucosal mastocytosis when correlated with CD117, tryptase and CD25 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Morphology of the eosinophilic infiltrate may be identical, and only demonstration of CD117/tryptase/CD25-positive mast cell aggregates establishes mastocytosis.
Parasite-associated eosinophilia may show larvae or ova and lacks aberrant CD25-positive mast cells.
Medication reactions give eosinophil-rich lamina propria often with apoptosis, and are excluded by drug history rather than morphology.
PDGFRA-rearranged neoplasms can mimic mastocytosis with eosinophils and CD25-positive mast cells, and are distinguished by FIP1L1::PDGFRA testing rather than KIT D816V.

62381.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中紅血球大小與血紅素含量不一：一群較小、中央淡染區擴大的低色素細胞，與另一群較大、色澤飽滿的正色素細胞同時存在，顯示雙相紅血球族群（dimorphic）；鐵劑治療中的缺鐵患者新生成的正常紅血球與舊的缺鐵紅血球並存即呈此表現。
features: Two red cell populations: smaller hypochromic cells with widened central pallor and larger normochromic cells
Moderate anisocytosis
Numerous crenated cells (echinocytes), likely drying/storage artifact
Occasional elongated/teardrop-like forms
Adequate small platelets scattered; no nucleated red cells or leukocytes in field
62381.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows moderate anisocytosis with two red cell populations: smaller hypochromic cells with increased central pallor and larger, well-hemoglobinized normochromic cells. Many cells are crenated, most consistent with a preparation artifact, which limits assessment of pallor in some cells. Platelets appear adequate, and no nucleated red cells are seen in this field. In a patient receiving iron therapy, the findings are consistent with a dimorphic red cell picture due to treated iron deficiency.

ddx.vs: Congenital or acquired sideroblastic anemia produces a dimorphic smear with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts in the marrow, without response to iron.
Transfused normal donor cells create dual populations, distinguished by transfusion history rather than morphology.
Mixed deficiency shows microcytes with macro-ovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, with low B12 or folate levels.

62125.recognize_zh: 淋巴結濾泡間區中央可見一個由淡粉紅色上皮樣組織球與多核巨細胞組成的小肉芽腫，周圍為密集小淋巴球，屬 Kimura 病濾泡間的肉芽腫反應。
features: Small non-necrotizing granuloma in the interfollicular region
Epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei
Multinucleated giant cells with clustered nuclei within the granuloma
Adjacent smaller aggregates of histiocytes and small vessels
Dense background of small mature lymphocytes
62125.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a dense background of small mature lymphocytes within which is a well-formed non-necrotizing granuloma composed of epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells. Smaller histiocytic aggregates and small vessels are present nearby in the interfollicular area. No caseous necrosis or atypical large cells are identified in this field. The granulomas are a nonspecific finding; in the context of eosinophilic microabscesses and germinal center IgE deposits, the findings are consistent with Kimura disease.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid granulomas are numerous, tight and confluent, often with asteroid or Schaumann bodies, and lack eosinophilic microabscesses.
Mycobacterial granulomas often have central caseous necrosis with acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Toxoplasmosis shows small epithelioid histiocyte clusters encroaching on germinal centers with monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia, without eosinophil abscesses.
Hodgkin lymphoma may contain granulomas but also has CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background.

62061.recognize_zh: 這是一支採血管的外觀照片：沿著管壁可見肉眼可辨的暗紅色顆粒狀紅血球凝集塊，上方血漿呈均勻橘紅色，符合室溫下冷凝集素造成的自發性紅血球凝集。
features: Gross photograph of a blood collection tube held horizontally
Macroscopic dark red granular clumps of red cells layered along the dependent tube wall
Clumps are discrete and coarse rather than a smooth homogeneous red-cell layer
Overlying fluid appears orange-red; degree of hemolysis cannot be quantified from the photo
62061.describe_en: Gross photograph of an anticoagulated blood sample shows coarse, macroscopically visible red cell agglutinates distributed along the dependent wall of the tube, in contrast to the uniform suspension expected in a normal sample. No microscopic detail is available from this image type. Spontaneous agglutination at room temperature that disperses on warming to 37 degrees C is characteristic of a cold agglutinin, and would be accompanied by spurious RBC count decrease and MCV/MCHC elevation on automated analyzers. Findings are consistent with cold agglutinin disease; confirmation requires a positive DAT for C3d with negative or weak IgG and a cold agglutinin titer.

ddx.vs: A clot is a single cohesive gelatinous mass that does not disperse on warming, whereas cold agglutinates are granular clumps that disperse at 37 degrees C.
Rouleaux are stacked coins on smear that disperse with saline replacement and are not typically visible as coarse clumps in the tube.
Warm IgG antibodies rarely cause gross agglutination at room temperature; DAT is IgG positive and smears show spherocytes rather than agglutinates.

exam.answer_en: Cold agglutinin disease — gross spontaneous RBC agglutination in the anticoagulated tube at room temperature
pearls_zh: 考法：給試管照片問 CBC 會怎樣：RBC 假性下降、MCV 與 MCHC 假性升高；檢體 37°C 加溫後重測可校正。
DAT：C3d 陽性、IgG 陰性或弱陽性；致病抗體多為 IgM，常見 anti-I 特異性。
續發原因：Mycoplasma pneumoniae（anti-I）、EBV（anti-i）、B 細胞淋巴增生性疾病；原發 CAD 常伴骨髓克隆性 B 細胞增生。
治療：保暖避寒；corticosteroid 效果差；rituximab 常用；補體 C1s 抑制劑 sutimlimab 已核准用於 CAD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被誤認為檢體凝固（clot）；血塊為單一膠狀塊、加溫不散，冷凝集為顆粒狀團塊且在 37°C 會分散。

quiz.q: 此檢體送 CBC，MCHC 最可能出現什麼變化？如何處理？
quiz.a: 假性升高；檢體 37°C 加溫後重測

61997.recognize_zh: 間期細胞核 FISH（TBL1XR1 綠色／TP63 紅色雙色融合探針）中，箭頭所指兩處紅綠重疊的黃色融合訊號，表示 TBL1XR1 與 TP63 發生融合；這是 TP63 重排 ALK 陰性 ALCL 最常見的融合伙伴，常由 3 號染色體倒位 inv(3)(q26q28) 造成。
features: Interphase nucleus (DAPI, grey) hybridized with TBL1XR1 (green) and TP63 (red) dual-color dual-fusion probes
Two yellow/overlapping red-green fusion signals (arrows) indicating TBL1XR1-TP63 fusion
Additional separate red signals (2) and multiple separate green signals (4) in the nucleus
Extra green signals suggest additional copies of the TBL1XR1 region or aneuploidy
Non-morphologic image: interpretation based on signal pattern, not cytology
61997.describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization using TBL1XR1 (green) and TP63 (red) dual-color dual-fusion probes shows two yellow fusion signals (arrows), together with separate red and green signals, including additional green signals that may reflect extra copies of the TBL1XR1 locus. Normal nuclei would show two separate red and two separate green signals without fusion. The presence of fusion signals indicates a TBL1XR1-TP63 rearrangement, the most common TP63 fusion (typically via inv(3)(q26q28)). In the context of a CD30-positive, ALK-negative lymphoma with diffuse p63 expression, this confirms TP63-rearranged ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma, an aggressive subgroup.

ddx.vs: Detected with DUSP22 break-apart probes at 6p25 and associated with p63 negativity and better prognosis, whereas this study shows TBL1XR1-TP63 fusion.
Detected with ALK break-apart probes and ALK immunostain positivity, both absent in this case.

ddx.dx: False-positive fusion from random signal overlap
ddx.vs: Chance colocalization occurs in a small percentage of normal nuclei; a validated cutoff across ≥100-200 scored nuclei is required.

61869.recognize_zh: 低倍視野中許多紅血球內可見細小環狀與點狀寄生蟲，部分紅血球含多個蟲體，紅血球間亦散佈小型蟲體，未見瘧色素或配子體，符合巴貝西蟲（Babesia）感染。
features: Many red cells containing small intraerythrocytic ring and dot forms
Several red cells harboring more than one parasite
Small extracellular forms between red cells (some may be platelets)
No pigment, schizonts or gametocytes; red cell size normal
Tetrads not resolvable at this magnification
Single small lymphocyte in the field
61869.describe_en: Giemsa-stained peripheral blood smear viewed at low magnification shows numerous red cells containing small intraerythrocytic ring and dot-like organisms, several red cells harboring multiple parasites. Small extracellular forms are present between red cells, some of which may be platelets. Infected red cells are normal in size, and no hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes are identified; tetrads cannot be resolved at this power. A single small lymphocyte is present. Findings are consistent with Babesia infection; high-power examination for tetrads, parasitemia quantification and PCR are recommended.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum shows appliqué and double-chromatin rings with possible banana-shaped gametocytes or pigment and no extracellular forms or tetrads.
Overlying platelets are granular with a surrounding halo and are not ring-shaped within the red cell plane.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single dense round inclusions, usually one per cell, without a pale central vacuole.

exam.answer_en: Babesiosis — small intraerythrocytic ring and dot forms, several per RBC, with extracellular forms and no pigment
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍照片先辨認紅血球內環狀體，再說出下一步：油鏡找 tetrad、計算寄生率。
確認：薄/厚血片 Giemsa 染色；形態不確定或寄生率低時以 PCR 確認並分辨物種。
傳播：以硬蜱叮咬為主，亦可經輸血及先天傳播。
重症危險因子：無脾、高齡、免疫抑制（如接受 rituximab 治療）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把重疊在紅血球上的血小板當成寄生蟲；血小板呈顆粒狀、有暈且焦面不同，Babesia 為紅血球內有淡中心的細環。

quiz.q: 紅血球內小環狀體、無瘧色素與配子體，最可能的病原？

61805.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖（非形態圖）：未 gate 的細胞中，紅色主族群 CD33 陽性、細胞質 MPO 由陰性延伸到強陽性，棕色族群 MPO 強陽性但 CD33 弱或陰性（成熟顆粒球），紫色族群兩者皆陰性（淋巴球）。
features: Ungated flow cytometry dot plot: cytoplasmic MPO-PE (x-axis) versus CD33-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Dominant red-colored population with moderate CD33 and MPO ranging from negative to bright
Brown-colored population with bright MPO and dim-to-negative CD33, consistent with maturing granulocytes
Purple/grey events negative for both markers, consistent with lymphocytes and other non-myeloid cells
61805.describe_en: Ungated flow cytometric analysis plotting cytoplasmic MPO against CD33 shows a dominant CD33-positive population (colored red, presumably the blast gate) with heterogeneous MPO expression spanning negative to bright. A separate brown population with bright MPO and dim-to-negative CD33 represents maturing granulocytes, and double-negative purple events represent lymphocytes. The cytoplasmic MPO expression in a subset of CD33-positive cells confirms myeloid lineage of the abnormal population in this GATA2-associated myeloid neoplasm; color-to-gate assignments should be confirmed against the full gating strategy.

61741.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交低倍圖中，許多深藍黑色的陽性細胞核成群聚集並環繞血管樣結構分佈，背景為大片粉紅色壞死物質；大量 EBV 陽性細胞呈血管中心性分佈並伴壞死，支持淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫病。
features: Numerous nuclei with dark blue-black EBER signal against a pink counterstain
Positive cells form clusters and cuffs around round vessel-like structures, suggesting an angiocentric distribution
Extensive pale pink necrotic/fibrinoid background between cellular aggregates
Density of positive cells is high in several fields (well over 50 per high-power field in aggregates), suggesting higher-grade disease
Low magnification limits confirmation that positive cells are the large atypical B cells
61741.describe_en: EBER in situ hybridization at low power shows numerous EBV-encoded RNA-positive nuclei arranged in clusters and perivascular cuffs within an extensively necrotic background. The positive cells appear to be distributed around vessel-like structures, supporting an angiocentric process. The density of EBER-positive cells appears high in aggregates, although precise counting and correlation with cell size require high-power examination and CD20 staining. Findings support EBV-driven lymphomatoid granulomatosis, likely higher grade given the number of positive cells.

ddx.vs: Also shows angiocentric EBER-positive cells with necrosis, but the EBER+ cells co-express CD56 and cytoplasmic CD3 rather than CD20.
EBER-positive large B cells form confluent sheets without the angiocentric distribution in a polymorphous background.
EBER highlights only scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30/CD15 positive and CD20 negative or weak.

ddx.dx: Background EBV-positive bystander lymphocytes (reactive or post-transplant)
ddx.vs: Consist of rare scattered small positive cells rather than dense perivascular aggregates of positive cells.

61677.recognize_zh: 這張九格合成圖（A–I）中，每格都可見兩顆白血球的核之間由一條細長的染色質絲相連（internuclear bridging），連接的多是成熟淋巴球或核形不規則的單核細胞，而不是紅血球前驅細胞，提示此現象並非只見於骨髓分化不良症或 CDA。
features: Composite of nine peripheral blood fields (A-I) showing pairs of leukocytes
Thin, thread-like chromatin bridges connecting the nuclei of two adjacent cells (clearly seen in A-H)
Bridged cells in A-E are small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and pale blue cytoplasm
Bridged cells in F-H have irregular to lobulated, condensed nuclei with moderate pale cytoplasm
Panel F and I include cells with coarse purple cytoplasmic granules; a bridge is not clearly visible in panel I
Background red cells without obvious abnormality at this resolution
61677.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear composite (panels A-I) shows multiple pairs of mononuclear leukocytes whose nuclei are joined by thin, elongated chromatin threads. The connected cells are predominantly small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei, while others have irregular or lobulated condensed nuclei; a few granular cells are also present, and in panel I a connecting bridge is not clearly identified at this resolution. The bridged cells are leukocytes rather than erythroid precursors. Findings illustrate internuclear chromatin bridging occurring outside the setting of myelodysplasia or congenital dyserythropoietic anemia, a non-specific finding that should not by itself be taken as evidence of dysplasia.

ddx.vs: In CDA I the chromatin bridges join erythroblasts in the bone marrow, accompanied by megaloblastoid change and spongy heterochromatin, rather than joining circulating lymphocytes.
MDS-associated internuclear bridging involves erythroid precursors or granulocytes together with other dysplastic features such as pseudo-Pelger-Huet nuclei, hypogranulation or ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Smear artifact with overlapping or stretched cells
ddx.vs: Artifactual strands are usually cytoplasmic or fibrin-like and do not show continuous purple chromatin staining connecting two distinct nuclei.

61613.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間造血組織與脂肪約各半，細胞呈間質性分布，低倍下看不出芽細胞細節；本圖僅能評估細胞量與結構，AML 診斷需高倍、抹片與分子檢測。
features: Moderately cellular marrow with admixed fat (roughly half cellularity at this power)
Interstitial distribution of hematopoietic cells without discrete nodules or aggregates
Scattered megakaryocytes visible at low power
Thin bony trabeculae without osteosclerosis
Cytologic detail (blast morphology) not resolvable at this magnification
61613.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a moderately cellular marrow with adipose tissue interspersed between thin bony trabeculae. Hematopoietic cells are distributed interstitially without nodular aggregates, fibrosis, or granulomas, and scattered megakaryocytes are identifiable. Cytologic detail is insufficient at this magnification to assess blast percentage or lineage. Correlation with higher-power sections, aspirate differential, immunohistochemistry (CD34), and molecular studies is required to support acute myeloid leukemia with mutated CEBPA.

ddx.vs: At low power a leukemic interstitial infiltrate can mimic normal cellularity; CD34 IHC and aspirate blast count are needed to exclude it.
Hypocellular AML shows <20% cellularity with blast clusters on CD34 staining, whereas this marrow is not hypocellular.
MDS may show similar cellularity; separation relies on dysplasia and a blast count below 20% on higher-power and aspirate review.

61549.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中倍下，髓腔被多形性浸潤取代：小淋巴球、大量嗜酸性球、組織球與纖維化間質，其間散在帶大核仁的大型非典型細胞（右上可見雙核樣細胞），正常造血只殘留於右下角，符合 CHL 骨髓侵犯。
features: Marrow space replaced by a polymorphous infiltrate in a fibrotic, spindle-cell-rich stroma
Numerous eosinophils admixed with small lymphocytes, plasma cells and histiocytes
Scattered large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, including a binucleate-appearing cell at upper right
Residual hematopoietic cells and a few adipocytes at lower right; bony trabecula at upper right corner
61549.describe_en: Medium-power view of a bone marrow biopsy shows replacement of the intertrabecular space by a polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, abundant eosinophils, plasma cells and histiocytes within a fibrotic stroma. Scattered large atypical cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli are present, including a binucleate-appearing form, while residual hematopoiesis is limited to the lower right. Some large cells may represent megakaryocytes, so confirmation with CD30, CD15 and PAX5 is required. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Mastocytosis contains spindled or oval mast cells with clear cytoplasm that are tryptase/CD117/CD25+, without large nucleolated CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow fibrosis with eosinophilia (e.g. drug reaction, parasitic infection)
ddx.vs: Reactive processes lack large atypical cells with inclusion-like nucleoli and CD30/CD15 co-expression.
PTCL shows atypical small-to-medium T cells with nuclear irregularity and aberrant immunophenotype in the background, rather than bland lymphocytes around rare HRS cells.
MPN shows atypical clustered megakaryocytes and increased myeloid cells rather than a lymphocyte- and eosinophil-rich infiltrate with HRS cells.

61485.recognize_zh: 這是細胞遺傳學影像而非血液形態：左下為核膜完整、染色質無法分辨的間期細胞（interphase），右側為染色體已凝縮並攤開、可見 G 帶條紋的中期分裂相（metaphase），後者才是做核型分析的對象。
features: Grayscale G-banded (GTG) preparation from cultured bone marrow aspirate cells
Interphase cell (lower left): round dense nucleus with no individually discernible chromosomes
Metaphase spread (right): condensed chromosomes spread without heavy overlap, showing light and dark bands
Chromosome count and structural abnormalities cannot be assessed from this unkaryotyped image
61485.describe_en: This is a cytogenetic image, not a morphologic smear, showing a GTG-banded preparation from a cultured bone marrow aspirate. An interphase nucleus (lower left) appears as a dense, round chromatin mass in which individual chromosomes cannot be resolved, whereas a metaphase cell (right) shows condensed, well-spread chromosomes with visible banding. Only metaphase cells with adequate spreading and banding are captured and arranged into a karyogram by length, centromere position and banding pattern; interphase cells require FISH for analysis. No karyotype interpretation is possible from this single spread, and results must be correlated with blood, aspirate and biopsy findings.

61421.recognize_zh: 睪丸腫瘤由瀰漫片狀的中大型母細胞樣淋巴細胞構成（A、B、F、G），Ki-67 幾近全陽性（C、H），流式顯示 CD10+ B 細胞族群，FISH 見 MYC 分離訊號（1R1G1Y），支持高惡性度 B 細胞淋巴瘤合併 MYC 重組；BCL2 重組的 FISH 未在此圖呈現。
features: Touch/cytology preparation (A): monotonous medium to large cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Tissue (B, F, G): diffuse sheets of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells effacing testicular parenchyma, with brisk mitoses
Ki-67 (C, H): very high proliferation index, approaching 100%
Flow cytometry (D): 41% CD10-positive B-cell population across CD20 expression; (E) second plot shows a proliferation/DNA parameter
FISH (I): MYC break-apart probe with 1R1G1Y pattern indicating MYC rearrangement
61421.describe_en: Composite figure: a cytologic preparation and testicular sections show diffuse sheets of monotonous medium to large lymphoid cells with fine chromatin, scant cytoplasm and numerous mitoses. Ki-67 labels nearly all tumor cells. Flow cytometry identifies a CD10-positive B-cell population, and MYC break-apart FISH shows a 1 red/1 green/1 fusion pattern consistent with MYC rearrangement. BCL2 and BCL6 FISH results are not depicted in this figure. In the context of prior follicular lymphoma and the stated double-hit status, findings are consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma is BCL2-negative with MYC as the sole rearrangement (no BCL2 break), whereas double-hit lymphoma carries BCL2 rearrangement and often arises from follicular lymphoma.
DLBCL NOS lacks concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, which only FISH can separate.
Lymphoblasts express TdT and often CD34 and lack surface immunoglobulin, unlike mature CD10+ germinal center B cells.
Seminoma cells have clear cytoplasm with lymphocyte-rich fibrous septa and are OCT3/4, SALL4 and CD117-positive but CD20/CD45-negative.

61421.stain: H&E; IHC: Ki-67; flow; FISH: MYC break-apart

61357.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞核內有一個圓形淡粉紅色的假包涵體（Dutcher body，免疫球蛋白堆積於核內），周圍為小至中型、染色質粗塊的淋巴漿細胞樣細胞；右下插圖抹片見偏心核、嗜鹼性細胞質的淋巴漿細胞，支持淋巴漿細胞性淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with clumped, coarse chromatin
Admixed plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei
Dutcher body: pale eosinophilic, round intranuclear pseudoinclusion (arrow) displacing chromatin to the periphery
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei; no sheets of large cells
Inset smear: lymphoplasmacytic cell with eccentric nucleus, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
61357.describe_en: Section shows a diffuse infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with coarse chromatin. A Dutcher body, a pale eosinophilic intranuclear pseudoinclusion of immunoglobulin, is identified (arrow). The inset smear demonstrates a lymphoplasmacytic cell with an eccentric nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, most suggestive of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, to be supported by an IgM paraprotein, a light-chain-restricted plasma cell component and MYD88 L265P mutation.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Dutcher bodies also occur in MZL; marginal zone/monocytoid cells, lymphoepithelial lesions and absence of MYD88 L265P favor MZL.
Myeloma consists of a pure plasma cell population (CD138+, CD19-/CD45-) without an accompanying clonal B-lymphocyte component and usually has a non-IgM paraprotein.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: Shows proliferation centers and CD5+/CD23+/LEF1+ phenotype rather than a CD5-negative lymphoplasmacytic population.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic without a clonal B-cell component, and Dutcher bodies are uncommon.

exam.answer_en: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma — small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with a Dutcher body (intranuclear Ig pseudoinclusion)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭處核內淡粉紅圓形包涵體，問「這叫什麼？本質是什麼？」答：Dutcher body，為細胞質免疫球蛋白內陷入核的假包涵體（PAS 陽性）。
分子：MYD88 L265P 見於絕大多數 LPL/Waldenström macroglobulinemia，CXCR4 突變約三分之一，後者與 ibrutinib 反應較差相關。
臨床：IgM 副蛋白可造成高黏滯症候群（視力模糊、出血、神經症狀）→ 需緊急血漿置換；亦可見冷凝球蛋白、周邊神經病變（anti-MAG）。
Waldenström macroglobulinemia＝LPL 侵犯骨髓並伴任何量的 IgM 單株蛋白。
exam.pitfall_zh: Dutcher body 非 LPL 專屬，易被當成確診依據；marginal zone lymphoma 與 myeloma 也可出現，需以 IgM 副蛋白、MYD88 L265P 與克隆性 B 細胞成分區分，並與核仁或細胞質重疊假影分開。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指核內包涵體的名稱為何？此淋巴瘤最常見的體細胞突變是？

61293.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片（cytospin）中出現數顆大型異型淋巴樣細胞，核形不規則、有切迹或分葉，染色質細緻並可見明顯核仁，細胞質淡藍含小空泡；在已知被套細胞淋巴瘤病人身上，這是母細胞樣/多形性變異型（blastoid/pleomorphic MCL）侵犯中樞神經的表現。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells, 2-3 times the size of red cells, in a clean background
Irregular nuclear contours with notches, clefts and lobulation
Finely dispersed to blastoid chromatin with one or more distinct nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with scattered small clear vacuoles
Cells cluster in small groups; no normal lymphocytes or monocytes for comparison in this field
61293.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows several large atypical lymphoid cells in a clean background with scattered red cells. The cells have irregular, notched to lobulated nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, distinct nucleoli and a moderate amount of pale blue, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. Mature small lymphocytes and monocytes are not seen in this field. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage; flow cytometry or cyclin D1/SOX11 immunocytochemistry is needed. In the setting of known disease, findings are consistent with CSF involvement by mantle cell lymphoma with blastoid/pleomorphic cytomorphology.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving CSF
ddx.vs: Can look identical; flow or immunostains showing CD5 with cyclin D1/SOX11 and t(11;14) favor MCL.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic or acute myeloid leukemia in CSF
ddx.vs: Blasts are usually more uniform with scanter cytoplasm and express TdT/CD34 or myeloid markers rather than mature B-cell markers with cyclin D1.
Have folded nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm but show condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli and are CD14/CD68 positive.
Forms cohesive three-dimensional clusters with nuclear molding and keratin positivity, lacking CD45.

61229.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交中，淋巴樣浸潤細胞的細胞核普遍呈深藍紫色陽性訊號，與粉紅色對比染色的腺體上皮對照明顯，表示腫瘤細胞瀰漫帶有 EBV。
features: Diffuse lymphoid infiltrate expanding the mucosa with residual glands in the upper portion
Dark blue-purple nuclear signal in the majority of infiltrating lymphoid cells
Glandular epithelium shows only pink counterstain (negative internal control)
Signal is strictly nuclear with no cytoplasmic staining
Positive cells extend to the surface and among glands
61229.describe_en: EBV-encoded RNA (EBER) in situ hybridization on the mucosal biopsy shows a dark nuclear signal in the vast majority of the infiltrating lymphoid cells, while residual glandular epithelium is negative with pink counterstain. Combined with the CD3+, CD56+ immunophenotype, the diffuse EBER positivity is consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, in which EBER positivity is essentially required for the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Reactive infiltrate with scattered EBV-positive cells
ddx.vs: Reactive conditions show only rare scattered EBER-positive cells rather than diffuse positivity in the majority of the infiltrate.
EBV+ DLBCL is also diffusely EBER positive but consists of large CD20/PAX5-positive B cells rather than CD3+/CD56+ cells.
MEITL is CD56 positive but EBER negative.

61165.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片顆粒邊緣的造血細胞與脂肪空泡之間，可見一條細長、呈迴旋彎曲的淡紫色線狀結構，符合微絲蟲的蟲體；下半部影像被灰色遮蔽，細節有限。
features: Edge of a marrow particle with mixed hematopoietic cells and fat spaces
Thin, curved, looped purple thread-like structure between cells at the center, consistent with a coiled microfilaria
Internal column of somatic nuclei and sheath are not clearly resolved at this magnification
Lower half of the image is obscured by a grey block, limiting assessment
61165.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at the edge of a particle shows mixed hematopoietic cells and fat spaces. Between the cells is a thin, looped, thread-like purple structure consistent with a coiled microfilaria, although internal nuclei, sheath and tail features cannot be resolved at this magnification, and the lower half of the image is obscured. In a patient with microfilariae also seen in the peripheral blood, the findings are consistent with filariasis; species identification requires high-power evaluation of sheath, nuclear column and tail, or a thick blood film.

ddx.dx: Fibrin strand or crushed nuclear material
ddx.vs: Artifactual strands are irregular and lack the uniform body width, rounded head and column of somatic nuclei of a microfilaria.
Trypanosomes are far smaller, with an undulating membrane, flagellum and kinetoplast, rather than a long coiled worm-like larva.
Contaminating fibers are refractile, lie in a different focal plane and lack internal nuclei.

61101.recognize_zh: 骨髓中的漿細胞與淋巴漿細胞樣細胞，細胞質內有多個大小不一、邊界清楚的透明大空泡（B、C 特別明顯）；免疫固定電泳只見 μ 重鏈的帶（箭頭）而無對應 κ 或 λ 輕鏈，是 μ 重鏈病的典型組合。
features: Aspirate (A, B): plasma cells and lymphoplasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Multiple large, sharply defined, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, sometimes indenting the nucleus
Cytochemical stain (C): cytoplasm stains pink-red around unstained empty vacuoles
Immunofixation (D): abnormal band in the anti-mu lane (arrow) without a corresponding kappa or lambda band
Immunoelectrophoresis (E): abnormal precipitin arc in the M region lacking light-chain reactivity (double arrow)
61101.describe_en: Composite figure. The bone marrow aspirate contains plasma cells and lymphoplasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm that harbor multiple large, sharply defined clear vacuoles, as further highlighted on a cytochemical stain in which the vacuoles remain unstained. Serum immunofixation shows an abnormal band reacting with anti-mu antiserum without an associated kappa or lambda band, and immunoelectrophoresis shows an abnormal mu arc lacking light-chain reactivity. Findings are consistent with mu heavy chain disease, typically associated with a CLL-like or lymphoplasmacytic B-cell neoplasm with characteristic vacuolated plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with Mott cells or Russell bodies
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple pale blue-pink immunoglobulin globules rather than empty clear vacuoles, and myeloma produces an intact monoclonal immunoglobulin or free light chain.
WM shows an IgM band with a matching kappa or lambda light chain and Dutcher bodies, not isolated mu chain.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: CLL lacks prominent large clear vacuoles and does not produce free mu heavy chain on immunofixation.
Alpha HCD involves the small intestine (IPSID) and immunofixation shows an alpha-chain band without light chain.

exam.answer_en: Mu heavy chain disease — vacuolated plasma cells in marrow with an anti-mu band lacking kappa/lambda on immunofixation
pearls_zh: 考法：組合圖考兩點：漿細胞胞質內大型透明空泡，以及免疫固定電泳只有 anti-μ 帶而無對應的 κ 或 λ 帶。
μ HCD 常合併 CLL 樣 B 細胞腫瘤；不少病例尿中可見游離輕鏈（Bence Jones protein），但與異常 μ 鏈不相連。
SPEP 常看不到明顯 M-spike，需靠 immunofixation / immunoelectrophoresis 才能發現異常重鏈。
三種 HCD：α HCD 最常見（IPSID，小腸）、γ HCD（Franklin disease）、μ HCD 最少見。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Waldenström macroglobulinemia；WM 的 IgM 帶必有對應 κ 或 λ 帶，本例 μ 帶無輕鏈；空泡也不要誤認成 Mott cell 的 Russell bodies。

quiz.q: 圖 D 箭頭處的異常帶與哪個抗血清反應、缺少什麼？診斷為何？
quiz.a: Anti-μ 陽性，無對應 κ/λ 帶；μ heavy chain disease

61037.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色中，只有散在少數的大型細胞呈膜狀及高基氏體（Golgi）點狀陽性，背景大量中小型細胞為陰性；這種「散在 CD30 陽性免疫母細胞」是 AITL 常見的伴隨發現，不代表整片為 CD30 陽性腫瘤。
features: Scattered large cells with membranous and paranuclear dot-like (Golgi) CD30 staining
Positive cells are large with round-to-oval vesicular nuclei and moderate cytoplasm (immunoblast-like)
Positive cells are dispersed singly or in small pairs, not forming sheets
Background of small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells that are CD30-negative, some with pale/clear cytoplasm
Weak, faint granular staining in some background cells
61037.describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemistry of a lymph node infiltrate shows scattered large immunoblast-like cells with membranous and paranuclear Golgi-pattern staining, distributed singly and in small clusters. The background population of small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells is CD30-negative. There are no cohesive sheets of CD30-positive cells. In a case of angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, these scattered CD30-positive large cells are most often EBV-associated B immunoblasts, which should be confirmed with CD20/PAX5 and EBER.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows sheets or sinusoidal clusters of uniformly strong CD30-positive hallmark cells rather than scattered isolated positive immunoblasts.
CHL CD30+ cells are Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are also CD15+ and weakly PAX5+ with CD45 negativity, set in a mixed inflammatory background without TFH-phenotype T cells.
Reactive nodes contain many CD30+ immunoblasts but retain architecture and lack an atypical TFH-marker-positive T-cell population.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: In PTCL-NOS the CD30-positive cells are the neoplastic T cells themselves (CD3+/CD20-), rather than B-lineage immunoblasts.

60973.recognize_zh: 周邊血紅血球大小形態不一並含 Pappenheimer 小體（箭頭），骨髓有核紅血球細胞質出現小空泡（D、E 箭頭），鐵染色可見環繞核周的藍色鐵顆粒（環形鐵粒幼紅血球），電顯證實有核紅血球內大量細胞質空泡，符合粒線體疾病相關的遺傳性鐵粒幼細胞貧血（MLASA2）。
features: Panel A (PB): anisopoikilocytosis with target-like and irregular red cells and a red cell containing basophilic Pappenheimer bodies (arrow)
Panels B-C (BM aspirate): erythroid precursors at various stages of maturation with deeply basophilic cytoplasm; mature granulocytes nearby; Pappenheimer bodies in a red cell (B, arrow)
Panels D-E: basophilic/polychromatophilic normoblasts with small, discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles (arrows)
Panels F-G (Prussian blue): ring sideroblasts with blue iron granules encircling at least one-third of the nucleus
Panel H (electron microscopy): normoblasts with numerous clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
60973.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with occasional red cells containing Pappenheimer bodies. The bone marrow aspirate shows erythroid maturation with scattered normoblasts containing small discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles, and the iron stain demonstrates numerous ring sideroblasts. Electron microscopy confirms abundant cytoplasmic vacuoles in erythroid precursors. In a young patient with myopathy and lactic acidosis, the combination of vacuolated erythroid precursors and ring sideroblasts is consistent with a mitochondrial syndromic sideroblastic anemia (MLASA2, YARS2-related).

ddx.vs: Shows identical vacuolated precursors and ring sideroblasts but presents in infancy with exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and mitochondrial DNA deletion; pancreatic elastase was normal here.
Produces microcytic hypochromic anemia with ring sideroblasts but no precursor vacuolization, myopathy or lactic acidosis, and often responds to pyridoxine.
Occurs in older adults with dysplasia and SF3B1 mutation; vacuoles are not a characteristic feature.

ddx.dx: Copper deficiency or zinc toxicity / alcohol / linezolid / chloramphenicol
ddx.vs: Also cause vacuolated precursors and ring sideroblasts, but are acquired and reversible with normal copper/zinc levels and no drug exposure excluding them here.

60909.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞體積巨大、核呈多葉/花瓣狀或雙核、染色質粗糙，失去典型偏心圓核與核旁淡染區，切片則為成片的多形性漿細胞；FISH 面板檢測 IGH/FGFR3、13q 與 TP53/CEP17，提示高風險骨髓瘤的間變性轉化。
features: Aspirate: markedly enlarged, pleomorphic plasma cells with multilobated, cloverleaf and binucleated nuclei
Coarse, clumped chromatin with deep blue cytoplasm; some cells lack a distinct perinuclear hof
Biopsy (H&E): hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and pleomorphism
Interphase FISH panels with probes for IGH/FGFR3 (t(4;14)), D13S319/13q34 (13q deletion) and TP53/CEP17 (17p deletion)
Scattered erythrocytes and residual hematopoietic cells in the background
60909.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow extensively replaced by sheets of atypical plasma cells with marked nuclear pleomorphism. The corresponding aspirate demonstrates large anaplastic plasma cells with multilobated, flower-like and binucleated nuclei, coarse chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm, far exceeding the size of normal plasma cells. Interphase FISH was performed with IGH/FGFR3, D13S319/13q34 and TP53/CEP17 probes; the individual signal patterns cannot be reliably scored at this resolution. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with anaplastic transformation.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma usually lacks a preceding myeloma, lytic bone lesions and serum paraprotein and is often EBER-positive and HIV-associated, whereas anaplastic myeloma retains myeloma cytogenetics such as t(4;14).
Metastatic cells form cohesive clusters and are CD138/light-chain negative with keratin or melanocytic markers, unlike these discohesive plasma cells.
Megakaryocytes have granular pink cytoplasm and a single lobulated nucleus, while these cells have basophilic plasmacytoid cytoplasm and are CD138 and light-chain restricted.
ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe nuclei and express CD30 and T-cell markers without cytoplasmic light-chain restriction.

60845.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿各階段嗜酸性球（含粗大橘紅色顆粒的前驅細胞），切片也見大量嗜酸性球浸潤，染色體圖顯示 t(8;9)(p11.2;q33.2)，涉及 FGFR1 所在的 8p11，符合伴 FGFR1 重排的骨髓性腫瘤。
features: Marked eosinophilia with mature eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors containing coarse orange-red and some immature dark-staining granules (panels A-B)
Admixed myeloid precursors, band/segmented neutrophils and monocytoid cells; eosinophil nuclei variably hypolobated
Several large immature cells with basophilic cytoplasm and granular inclusions in the aspirate smear
Bone marrow biopsy (panel C) hypercellular with sheets of eosinophils (bright eosinophilic cytoplasm) among myeloid cells
Partial karyotype (panel D) shows t(8;9)(p11.2;q33.2) with arrows at the breakpoints on chromosomes 8 and 9
60845.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a hypercellular myeloid population with marked eosinophilia, including numerous eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with coarse orange and admixed dark immature granules, together with neutrophilic precursors and occasional large immature cells. The trephine biopsy is hypercellular with abundant eosinophils. The partial karyotype demonstrates t(8;9)(p11.2;q33.2), placing a breakpoint at the FGFR1 locus (8p11.2). Findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and FGFR1 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophilia lacks a clonal cytogenetic abnormality and dysplastic immature eosinophil granules; an 8p11 rearrangement defines the neoplasm.

FIP1L1::PDGFRA is cryptic on karyotype and detected by FISH/RT-PCR (CHIC2 deletion) with mast cell increase and imatinib sensitivity, whereas FGFR1 cases show 8p11 translocations and are imatinib-resistant.
CEL requires clonality or increased blasts in the absence of PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2/FLT3/ETV6::ABL1 rearrangement.
AML with CBFB::MYH11 has increased blasts, monocytic differentiation and abnormal eosinophils with basophilic granules plus chromosome 16 abnormality rather than an 8p11 translocation.

captions: A-B: marrow aspirate smears with marked eosinophilia and eosinophil precursors; C: hypercellular marrow biopsy rich in eosinophils; D: partial karyotype showing t(8;9)(p11.2;q33.2)

60781.recognize_zh: 高倍下是一片單形的中型細胞，核圓至略不規則、染色質細緻分散如淋巴母細胞、核仁小，並散在多個有絲分裂象與凋亡小體，呈現母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤的高增生樣貌。
features: Monotonous sheet of medium-sized lymphoid cells with scant pale cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular or indented nuclei with finely dispersed, blast-like chromatin and small inconspicuous nucleoli
Numerous mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies
Occasional tingible body macrophages with vacuolated cytoplasm, but no well-developed starry-sky pattern
Thin fibrovascular septum with a few larger stromal/endothelial nuclei at right
60781.describe_en: High-power section shows a diffuse, monotonous proliferation of medium-sized lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm, round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli, resembling lymphoblasts. Mitotic figures are numerous, and scattered apoptotic bodies and occasional tingible body macrophages are present. The morphology alone does not establish lineage. Together with CD20 and cyclin D1 positivity and a Ki-67 index above 90%, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant.

ddx.vs: Morphology is essentially indistinguishable; TdT and CD34 expression without cyclin D1 favors lymphoblastic lymphoma.
Cells have multiple small nucleoli, squared-off cytoplasmic borders with lipid vacuoles and a prominent starry-sky pattern, with a CD10+/BCL2-/cyclin D1- phenotype.

ddx.dx: Pleomorphic variant of mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Cells are larger and more heterogeneous with prominent nucleoli, rather than the uniform fine-chromatin blastoid cells seen here.
Blasts often show more eosinophilic cytoplasm and admixed eosinophilic myelocytes, and express MPO/CD117/CD33 instead of CD20 and cyclin D1.

exam.answer_en: Mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant — monotonous medium-sized cells with fine blast-like chromatin and numerous mitoses (cyclin D1+ required)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指細緻染色質、類似淋巴母細胞的單形細胞與多數分裂象，問「只看 H&E 能定 lineage 嗎？下一步 IHC？」→ 不能；做 CD20、CD5、cyclin D1、SOX11、TdT、Ki-67。
Blastoid vs pleomorphic MCL：blastoid 細胞一致、染色質細緻如淋巴母細胞；pleomorphic 細胞較大、較不一致且核仁明顯。兩者皆為侵襲性變異型。
預後：blastoid 型態、Ki-67 ≥30%、TP53 突變或 17p 缺失都是不良預後因子，常對傳統化學免疫療法反應差。
TdT 在 MCL 為陰性，是與 lymphoblastic lymphoma 區分的關鍵；少數 blastoid MCL 可出現 CD10 或失去 CD5，勿因此排除 MCL。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 lymphoblastic lymphoma：形態幾乎無法區分，但 LBL 為 TdT+、CD34+ 且 cyclin D1 陰性；blastoid MCL 為 CD20+、cyclin D1+、TdT−。

quiz.q: 圖中類似淋巴母細胞的單形細胞，區分 blastoid MCL 與 lymphoblastic lymphoma 最關鍵的兩個 IHC 是？
quiz.a: Cyclin D1（MCL 陽性）與 TdT（LBL 陽性）

60589.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞細胞質內塞滿大量大小一致、約 2–4 µm、有透明暈圈的小型酵母菌（莢膜組織漿菌），另一巨噬細胞同時吞噬紅血球系細胞與酵母菌，呈現噬血現象，符合播散性組織漿菌病合併 HLH。
features: Macrophages with abundant cytoplasm packed with numerous small, uniform oval yeasts (about 2-4 um)
Each yeast has a central dark-staining body with a thin clear halo; no wide capsule
Macrophage containing an engulfed erythroid cell/red cell together with yeasts (hemophagocytosis, panel B)
Background of maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
60589.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm containing numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular yeast forms with a central basophilic body and a thin clear halo. A macrophage in panel B contains a phagocytosed red cell/erythroid element in addition to yeast forms, indicating hemophagocytosis. The background shows trilineage hematopoiesis. In a febrile patient with pancytopenia and hepatosplenomegaly, findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis with secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis; confirmation by GMS stain, Histoplasma antigen and culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain a nucleus plus a bar-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo; they are GMS negative.
Talaromyces yeasts are more elongated and divide by fission with a central septum rather than budding.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Shows hemophagocytosis alone without intracellular organisms; genetic testing (PRF1, UNC13D) establishes primary HLH.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis with secondary HLH — marrow macrophages packed with uniform 2–4 µm haloed yeasts, one also engulfing an erythroid cell
pearls_zh: 考法：同一張圖同時考「病原」與「現象」——指小酵母答 Histoplasma capsulatum，指吞噬紅系細胞的巨噬細胞答 hemophagocytosis，最後整合為感染誘發的 secondary HLH。
HLH 必考檢驗：ferritin 明顯升高、sCD25（sIL-2R）升高、三酸甘油酯升高、纖維蛋白原下降、NK 活性下降；診斷依 HLH-2004（8 項中 5 項）或遺傳證據。
Histoplasma 確認：尿液/血清 antigen 對播散型敏感度高、GMS/PAS 染色、真菌培養（需數週）；危險族群為 HIV、移植、TNF inhibitor 使用者。
治療邏輯：感染引起的 HLH 首重治療病原（重症以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導、itraconazole 續用），必要時再加 HLH 導向免疫抑制；單用化療/類固醇而不治感染可能致命。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Talaromyces marneffei 混淆：Talaromyces 大小不一、有香腸狀長形菌並以中央橫隔二分裂；Histoplasma 大小一致、卵圓、有透明暈並以出芽繁殖。

quiz.q: 圖 B 巨噬細胞同時吞入紅系細胞與小酵母，這種吞噬血球現象的名稱是什麼？單憑此現象能否確診 HLH？
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis；不能，需符合 HLH-2004 臨床/檢驗標準（8 項中 5 項）或分子診斷。

60653.recognize_zh: 背景為成熟嗜中性球與單核球系細胞增多，另有核摺疊、染色質細緻的前單核球／芽細胞，其細胞質內可見細長的 Auer 小體，符合慢性骨髓單核球性白血病第二型（CMML-2）。
features: Mixture of segmented neutrophils, monocytes and immature monocytic cells (promonocytes/blasts)
Immature cells with folded or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm
Thin, needle-like Auer rods in the cytoplasm of occasional immature cells (panel A lower cell, panel B lower center cell)
Neutrophils mostly segmented with normal to slightly reduced granulation; a granulated myelocyte-like cell in panel A
Scattered platelets and a small lymphocyte; red cells without significant poikilocytosis
60653.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows granulocytes and monocytic cells together with scattered immature cells having delicate chromatin, folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm, consistent with promonocytes and blasts. Occasional immature cells contain slender Auer rods. Mature neutrophils show relatively preserved granulation. Findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia; the presence of Auer rods places the case in CMML-2 irrespective of blast count (WHO 2016).

ddx.vs: AML requires ≥20% blasts plus promonocytes in blood or marrow, whereas CMML has fewer blast equivalents with persistent monocytosis.
Reactive monocytes are mature, without increased promonocytes, dysplasia or Auer rods.
aCML shows marked dysgranulopoiesis with immature granulocytes ≥10% and monocytes <10% of leukocytes.
MDS-EB lacks the persistent absolute monocytosis (≥1 × 10^9/L and ≥10%) required for CMML.

60717.recognize_zh: 骨髓中巨噬細胞體積大、細胞質內可見被吞噬的有核細胞與紅血球（噬血現象），並夾雜深色顆粒狀殘骸；切片、鐵染色與組織球免疫染色都顯示吞噬了細胞的大型巨噬細胞，符合噬血性淋巴組織球增多症（HLH）。
features: Aspirate (A): large macrophage with abundant cytoplasm containing an engulfed nucleated cell and numerous dark coarse phagocytosed granules/debris
Section (B): enlarged histiocytes with ingested erythrocytes and nucleated cells within cytoplasmic vacuoles
Special stain (C): macrophage with blue-green granular cytoplasm containing a phagocytosed nucleated cell (red) and several red cells (yellow-green)
IHC (D): strong brown cytoplasmic staining of numerous large histiocytes, many enclosing phagocytosed cells (histiocytic marker, unlabeled)
Background mixed hematopoietic cells; no neoplastic infiltrate or organisms identifiable at this magnification
60717.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate and biopsy show increased activated macrophages with abundant cytoplasm containing ingested nucleated hematopoietic cells, erythrocytes and dark cellular debris. A special stain highlights a macrophage enclosing a nucleated cell and several red cells, and an immunostain for a histiocytic marker (not labeled) demonstrates numerous large positive macrophages with engulfed cells. No lymphoma infiltrate or microorganisms are evident in these images. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis supporting hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, here in association with granulomatosis with polyangiitis; HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria (ferritin, soluble CD25, fibrinogen, triglycerides) should be applied.

ddx.vs: Occasional hemophagocytic macrophages are nonspecific, so HLH requires the clinical/laboratory criteria rather than morphology alone.
Leishmania shows numerous small amastigotes with nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast in macrophages, which are not identified here.
Storage cells have wrinkled tissue-paper or foamy cytoplasm without engulfed intact blood cells.
An underlying lymphoma shows atypical lymphoid infiltrates on biopsy, clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement or EBER positivity, none evident in these panels.

captions: Aspirate: macrophage with engulfed nucleated cell and dark debris
Section: histiocytes containing phagocytosed red cells and nucleated cells
Special stain: macrophage enclosing a nucleated cell and red cells
Histiocytic IHC: numerous large macrophages with ingested cells

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis in bone marrow supporting HLH (GPA-associated) — activated macrophages engulfing nucleated hematopoietic cells and RBCs
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指胞質內含完整有核細胞與紅血球的巨噬細胞，問「這是什麼現象？可能診斷？」→ hemophagocytosis，懷疑 HLH。
HLH-2004 需符合分子診斷或 8 項中 5 項：發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球低下、高三酸甘油酯和/或低纖維蛋白原、組織噬血、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500、sCD25 ≥2400 U/mL。
骨髓噬血現象既不敏感也不特異；成人可用 HScore 評估機率，並務必找誘因：感染（EBV、Leishmania）、淋巴瘤、自體免疫（MAS）。
IHC CD163/CD68 可凸顯增加的巨噬細胞與被吞噬細胞，有助於切片上辨識噬血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把輸血、敗血症後的孤立噬血現象直接診斷為 HLH：無臨床與實驗室診斷標準支持時只能描述為 hemophagocytosis，並需排除 Leishmania 與淋巴瘤。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞吞噬有核細胞與紅血球稱為什麼現象？HLH-2004 標準中 ferritin 門檻為何？

60525.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見多核巨細胞，細胞核沿周邊排成馬蹄形／花環狀（Langhans 型巨細胞），周圍有核呈細長鞋底狀的類上皮組織球聚集，形成肉芽腫；本視野未見乾酪樣壞死。
features: Multinucleated Langhans-type giant cell with nuclei arranged peripherally in a horseshoe/wreath pattern and central eosinophilic cytoplasm
Second giant cell in the lower left
Surrounding epithelioid histiocytes with elongated, pale, slipper-shaped nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Loose admixed lymphocytes and a fibrillary pale stroma replacing normal hematopoietic marrow in this field
No caseous necrosis in this field; bony trabeculae at the edges and a dark pink artifactual fragment
60525.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at medium power shows a granulomatous focus replacing the normal hematopoietic tissue. It is composed of sheets of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated pale nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed lymphocytes, and at least two multinucleated Langhans-type giant cells with peripherally arranged nuclei. No caseous necrosis is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with non-caseating granulomatous inflammation of the marrow; special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi, cultures, and clinical correlation are required, with tuberculosis, other infections, sarcoidosis, drugs, and lymphoma-associated granulomas in the differential.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas often show central caseous necrosis and AFB on ZN stain or culture, although marrow granulomas may be non-caseating and AFB-negative.
Sarcoid granulomas are tight, well-formed, and non-necrotizing with asteroid or Schaumann bodies, and require exclusion of infection.
Fungal granulomas contain small yeasts demonstrable on GMS or PAS stains.
Hodgkin involvement shows scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30+/CD15+ within a mixed inflammatory background.

60461.recognize_zh: 皮膚穿刺切片低倍下，真皮從表皮下方至深層幾乎被密集、深紫藍色的瀰漫性淋巴樣浸潤佔滿，僅少量膠原束夾雜，表皮下幾乎沒有明顯的無浸潤帶，符合腿型原發皮膚瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的分布。
features: Skin punch biopsy with dense diffuse basophilic infiltrate filling the entire dermis
Infiltrate extends from the superficial papillary dermis to the deep margin
Little to no uninvolved grenz zone beneath the epidermis
Residual collagen bundles and adnexal structures entrapped within the infiltrate
Intact thin epidermis with basket-weave keratin; cytology not assessable at this power
60461.describe_en: Low-power view of a skin punch biopsy shows a dense, diffuse, monotonous-appearing lymphoid infiltrate occupying the full thickness of the dermis and extending to the deep margin, with entrapped collagen bundles. The infiltrate closely abuts the overlying intact epidermis with little to no grenz zone. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The pattern is consistent with a cutaneous lymphoma and, with large cell cytology and a CD20+, BCL2+, MUM1+ phenotype, supports primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type.

ddx.vs: PCFCL shows centrocytes and centroblasts, often with follicular remnants, and is typically BCL2 negative/weak and MUM1 negative, favoring head and trunk sites.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: PCMZL is composed of small marginal zone cells and plasma cells in nodular/diffuse patterns with reactive germinal centers, not sheets of large cells.
Myeloid or BPDCN infiltrates are CD20 negative and express myeloid markers or CD4/CD56/CD123.

60269.recognize_zh: 背景許多紅血球出現靶形、摺疊或不規則形，並散在數顆深紅色、邊緣筆直的長方形或六角棒狀結晶，有些位於幾乎透明的紅血球膜內（如「金條」），為血紅素C結晶（HbC crystals）的典型表現。
features: Several dense, dark red, rectangular to hexagonal rod-shaped crystals with straight parallel edges, some within otherwise clear red cell membranes
Numerous target cells and folded/irregularly contoured red cells
Occasional microspherocyte-like dense cells and echinocytic forms
Mild anisopoikilocytosis
Single small lymphocyte (lower left) and scattered platelets
60269.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous target cells and folded red cells. Scattered dense, dark-staining rectangular hemoglobin crystals with blunt straight edges are present, several lying within an otherwise hemoglobin-depleted red cell membrane. Sickle cells are not identified. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin C disease (HbCC).

ddx.vs: HbSC crystals are irregular, often with finger-like or boat-shaped protrusions, and occasional sickle cells may be present, whereas HbC crystals are regular rectangles; confirm by hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC.
Shows microcytic hypochromic target cells with basophilic stippling but no intracellular hemoglobin crystals.
Target cells occur without dense rod-shaped crystals, and liver-disease targets are typically macrocytic.

exam.answer_en: Hemoglobin C disease (HbCC) — rectangular 'gold bar' HbC crystals within hemoglobin-depleted red cells plus numerous target cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著邊緣筆直的深紅色長方形結晶問「這是什麼」——答 HbC crystal；並常追問背景大量 target cells 的意義。
分子機轉：β-globin 第 6 位 glutamic acid → lysine（HbS 則是 → valine）；HbC 溶解度低、易結晶並使紅血球脫水，MCHC 常偏高。
確認檢查：hemoglobin HPLC 或電泳；在 alkaline（cellulose acetate）電泳中 HbC 與 HbA2、HbE、HbO 同位置遷移，需以 HPLC 或 acid 電泳區分。
臨床：HbCC 通常為輕度慢性溶血與脾腫大，HbC trait 無症狀；結晶在脾切除後更易見。HbSC 則會有血管阻塞併發症（如 proliferative retinopathy）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 HbSC disease 混淆；HbSC 結晶形狀不規則、帶指狀或船形突起（'Washington monument'），並可能見到少數鐮刀細胞，HbC 結晶則為規則長方形或六角形，最後以 HPLC 確認。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球內長方形的深色結晶是什麼？其對應的 β-globin 胺基酸置換為何？

60141.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央是一顆雙葉核的嗜酸性球，但胞質大部分呈淡藍灰色、只有稀疏的橘紅色顆粒（顆粒減少），這種型態異常的嗜酸性球提示為克隆性嗜酸性球增多，如PDGFRA重排腫瘤。
features: Single eosinophil with a bilobed nucleus and moderately condensed chromatin
Sparse, unevenly distributed orange-red granules with large areas of agranular pale blue-gray cytoplasm (hypogranulation)
Cytoplasmic vacuolation/clearing is not prominent; cell size within normal eosinophil range
Background red cells are normocytic with occasional crenated forms; few platelets
60141.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an eosinophil with a bilobed nucleus and abnormally sparse, unevenly distributed eosinophilic granules, leaving much of the cytoplasm agranular and pale blue-gray. The surrounding red cells are largely normocytic with occasional crenated cells, and platelets are sparse in this field. A single cell cannot establish eosinophilia; however, hypogranular eosinophils in the context of persistent marked eosinophilia raise concern for a clonal eosinophilic disorder, consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA rearrangement when FIP1L1::PDGFRA is demonstrated.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils can also be hypogranular or vacuolated, so morphology is not specific; separation requires clinical workup and genetic testing for PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement.
Neutrophils have 3–5 lobes and fine dark purple toxic granules in pink cytoplasm, not large orange-red refractile eosinophilic granules.
Basophils have coarse dark purple-black granules overlying the nucleus rather than sparse orange-red granules.
An eosinophilic myelocyte has a round non-lobated nucleus with mixed immature basophilic granules, whereas this cell has a mature bilobed nucleus.

60077.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有核細胞幾乎都是顆粒球系（前髓細胞、髓細胞、帶狀與分葉嗜中性球、嗜伊紅球），紅血球系成熟階段的母紅血球幾乎看不到；右圖中央只有一顆大型、深藍色細胞質、核圓且染色質細緻的早期紅血球前驅細胞（pronormoblast）；這種「只剩少數早期紅系、缺乏成熟母紅血球」是 Diamond-Blackfan anemia 的骨髓特徵。
features: Marked myeloid predominance: promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, and eosinophils
Rare large early erythroid precursor (pronormoblast) with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nucleus with fine chromatin
Near absence of maturing polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Granulocytic maturation orderly without dysplasia or increased myeloblasts
Scattered small lymphocytes; red cells show brownish staining artifact
60077.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marked myeloid predominance, with granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation including promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils, and eosinophils, without dysplasia or increased blasts. Erythroid precursors are markedly reduced; only a rare large early erythroid precursor with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and fine nuclear chromatin is seen, and maturing polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts are virtually absent. Scattered small lymphocytes are present. Findings are consistent with selective erythroid hypoplasia with maturation arrest at the early precursor stage, as seen in Diamond-Blackfan anemia in the appropriate clinical setting (macrocytic anemia, reticulocytopenia in infancy).

ddx.vs: Also shows erythroid aplasia with preserved myelopoiesis, but occurs in older children with normocytic red cells, normal HbF and red cell ADA, and recovers spontaneously.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19-induced pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Characterized by giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions and cytoplasmic vacuoles, confirmed by B19 PCR.

ddx.dx: Acquired pure red cell aplasia (thymoma, autoimmune, drugs)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar erythroid aplasia but occurs in adults and is associated with thymoma, LGL leukemia, or drugs rather than congenital ribosomal protein mutations.
Shows vacuolated erythroid and myeloid precursors with ring sideroblasts and mitochondrial DNA deletion.

exam.answer_en: Diamond–Blackfan anemia — marrow with orderly granulopoiesis but near-absent maturing erythroid precursors, only rare pronormoblasts (selective erythroid hypoplasia)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會請你估 M:E ratio 並指出紅系在哪；答顆粒系成熟完整、紅系幾近消失僅剩少數 pronormoblast，屬純紅血球再生不良（pure red cell aplasia）型態。
遺傳：核糖體蛋白基因突變（最常見 RPS19，其次 RPL5、RPL11、RPS26 等），多為體染色體顯性；少數為 X-linked GATA1。
檢驗線索：嬰兒期（多在 1 歲內）大球性貧血、網狀紅血球極低、HbF 升高、erythrocyte adenosine deaminase（eADA）升高；約半數合併先天異常如拇指畸形與顏面異常。
治療與預後：類固醇為一線，無效需長期輸血並排鐵；HSCT 可根治；具癌症傾向（MDS/AML、osteosarcoma、大腸癌）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 transient erythroblastopenia of childhood（TEC）混淆：TEC 發生在較大幼兒、正球性、eADA 與 HbF 正常且數週內自行恢復；parvovirus B19 則可見帶核內包涵體的 giant pronormoblast。

quiz.q: 嬰兒大球性貧血、骨髓如圖紅系幾乎消失，哪一項紅血球酵素檢查升高可支持 Diamond-Blackfan anemia？

60013.recognize_zh: 紅色母細胞群 CD45 弱陽、SSC 低，表現 CD34、CD117、CD13 與弱陽性 CD33，細胞內 MPO 部分陽性；CD19、CD7、CD3、CD15 與細胞內 CD79a 皆陰性，確認為髓系母細胞而非淋巴或混合表型。
features: Blasts (red) in the CD45-dim, low side scatter gate
CD34 and CD117 positive
CD13 positive with dim CD33
Partial intracellular MPO positivity
Negative for CD19, CD7, CD3, CD15, and intracellular CD79a
60013.describe_en: Flow cytometric immunophenotyping shows an expanded blast population with dim CD45 and low side scatter. The blasts are positive for CD34, CD117, and CD13, with dim CD33 and partial intracellular myeloperoxidase expression. B-lineage (CD19, cytoplasmic CD79a) and T-lineage (CD3, CD7) markers are negative, and CD15 is not expressed, indicating little maturation. The immunophenotype is that of myeloid blasts, consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; assignment to the myelodysplasia-related category depends on morphologic dysplasia, cytogenetics, or prior MDS history.

ddx.vs: MPAL requires lineage-specific B or T markers such as strong CD19 with cCD79a or cytoplasmic CD3, which are absent here.
AML-M0 shows fewer than 3% MPO-positive blasts, whereas a distinct subset here is MPO positive.
Monocytic differentiation would show CD14, CD64, CD11b, or CD36 with brighter CD45 and higher side scatter, not this CD34/CD117-positive immature profile.

29549.recognize_zh: A 圖為鱗狀上皮下真皮組織，膠原間散布非典型大型細胞浸潤；B 圖在脂肪組織背景中大型異型細胞呈深黑色核訊號，型態上符合 EBV 原位雜交（EBER ISH）陽性的大型淋巴瘤細胞。標題中的乳酸酸中毒屬臨床資訊，無法由圖像判讀。
features: Panel A: squamous epithelium with underlying dermis containing a perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of atypical cells with enlarged hyperchromatic nuclei
Panel B: large atypical cells with strong dark nuclear signal scattered among adipocytes
Positive cells are large with irregular nuclei and vacuolated/foamy surrounding cytoplasm
Staining method in panel B is not labeled; the dark nuclear signal pattern resembles EBER in situ hybridization
Image quality and color cast limit fine cytologic assessment
29549.describe_en: Composite figure. Panel A (H&E) shows squamous epithelium with an underlying dermal infiltrate of atypical cells with enlarged hyperchromatic nuclei among collagen bundles and small vessels. Panel B shows large atypical cells within adipose tissue with a strong dark nuclear signal, a pattern consistent with EBER in situ hybridization, although the stain is not labeled. Resolution and color balance limit detailed cytologic assessment, and the metabolic complication (lactic acidosis) cannot be evaluated morphologically. Findings are suggestive of an EBV-positive large B-cell lymphoma in an HIV-positive patient, requiring CD20/PAX5, CD30, MUM1, Ki-67 and EBER studies for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma is also EBER positive in HIV but is CD20/PAX5 negative and expresses CD138, MUM1 and PRDM1 with plasmacytoid morphology.
Extracavitary PEL is HHV-8 (LANA) positive, usually CD20 negative, whereas EBV-positive DLBCL is HHV-8 negative.
Kaposi sarcoma is a spindle cell vascular proliferation with slit-like spaces and HHV-8 positivity rather than discohesive large lymphoid cells.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and monotonous with a starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement.

28141.recognize_zh: 上肢皮膚出現許多細小、以毛囊為中心的紅色斑疹，局部融合成不規則紅斑片，無水泡或鱗屑；移植後出現這種麻疹樣／毛囊周圍紅疹，應考慮早期急性 GVHD。
features: Numerous small erythematous macules and papules, many centered on hair follicles
Focal coalescence into irregular erythematous patches
Blanching-appearing erythema without purpura
No vesicles, bullae, scale or sclerosis
Intervening skin largely spared
28141.describe_en: Close-up clinical photograph of the extremity shows numerous small erythematous macules and follicular papules that coalesce focally into irregular patches. There is no scale, vesiculation, purpura or sclerosis. In an allogeneic transplant recipient, a morbilliform eruption with perifollicular accentuation is consistent with early cutaneous acute graft-versus-host disease; skin biopsy and review of medications and viral studies are needed to exclude mimics.

ddx.vs: Clinically similar; timing with a new drug and dermal eosinophils favor drug, whereas follicular involvement and basal apoptotic keratinocytes favor GVHD.
Folliculitis produces discrete pustules or papules centered on follicles without confluent macular erythema.
Accompanied by fever and systemic viral signs with positive PCR serology, and lacks progression to acral or ear involvement typical of GVHD.

19949.recognize_zh: 背景充滿深染、無中央淡染區的小球形紅血球（microspherocytes），並散在淡色紅血球殘影（ghost cells），而白血球胞質內可見被吞噬的粗大桿菌（箭頭），提示產氣莢膜梭菌（Clostridium perfringens）敗血症造成的大量血管內溶血。
features: Leukocytes (neutrophil and a monocytoid cell) containing intracytoplasmic rod-shaped bacilli within clear vacuoles (arrows)
Numerous small, dense microspherocytes lacking central pallor
Pale erythrocyte ghosts and variable red cell density indicating intravascular lysis
Relatively sparse red cells in one field consistent with severe anemia
Platelets present in the background
19949.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking population of small, densely staining microspherocytes admixed with pale red cell ghosts, reflecting fulminant intravascular hemolysis. Two leukocytes contain phagocytosed bacilli within cytoplasmic vacuoles (arrows). No red cell agglutination or schistocyte-predominant picture is evident. In a septic diabetic patient, findings are consistent with Clostridium perfringens bacteremia with toxin-mediated massive intravascular hemolysis; blood culture confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: HS shows uniform spherocytes without red cell ghosts, intracellular bacteria, or a fulminant septic clinical picture.
AIHA spherocytes are accompanied by polychromasia and a positive DAT rather than ghost cells and phagocytosed bacilli.
Thermal injury produces microspherocytes and budding red cell fragments but no intracellular organisms.
Organism shape differs (cocci or thin fusiform rods) and the massive microspherocytic hemolysis typical of clostridial alpha-toxin is lacking; culture and Gram stain identify the organism.

exam.answer_en: Clostridium perfringens sepsis with massive intravascular hemolysis — microspherocytes and red cell ghosts with phagocytosed bacilli in leukocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：指著白血球空泡內的粗桿菌問「是什麼菌？背景紅血球有何變化？」→ C. perfringens（Gram-positive rod）；大量 microspherocytes 與 ghost cells。
機轉：alpha-toxin（phospholipase C/lecithinase）破壞紅血球膜磷脂，造成急速血管內溶血。
實驗室線索：血漿呈紅色、hemoglobinemia/hemoglobinuria，Hb 與 Hct 明顯不成比例（MCHC 假性升高），LDH 極高。
急症：死亡率高，需立即高劑量 penicillin 合併 clindamycin 並積極處理感染源（如肝膿瘍、腸道或婦科來源）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 大量球形紅血球易誤判為 warm AIHA 或 hereditary spherocytosis；本病有 ghost cells、白血球內桿菌與敗血症表現，DAT 陰性，需血液培養確認。

quiz.q: 敗血症病人血片滿是 microspherocytes 並見白血球內粗大桿菌，最可能的病原為何？其溶血毒素是什麼？

15149.recognize_zh: A 圖成熟嗜中性球只有兩個對稱圓形核葉，由細絲相連呈「夾鼻眼鏡」狀（pince-nez），B 圖為粗染色質、不分葉的帶狀核，細胞質顆粒正常；染色質高度凝集卻分葉不足，加上家族性（標題「有其子必有其父」），符合遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly。
features: A: mature neutrophil with two symmetric round nuclear lobes joined by a thin filament (pince-nez/spectacle form)
B: neutrophil with a non-segmented, band-like (peanut/dumbbell) nucleus
Markedly coarse, clumped mature chromatin despite hypolobation
Normal cytoplasmic granulation without dysgranulopoiesis or toxic change
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable
15149.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with hypolobated nuclei: a symmetric bilobed neutrophil with two round lobes connected by a thin chromatin bridge, giving a pince-nez appearance (A), and a band-like, non-segmented form (B). Despite the reduced lobation, the nuclear chromatin is coarse and densely clumped, indicating a mature cell, and the cytoplasm shows normal pink granulation without hypogranularity or toxic changes. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. The predominance of such cells (47% bilobed, 45% band forms per the legend) in a healthy adult with a similarly affected relative is consistent with inherited Pelger-Huet anomaly (heterozygous LBR mutation).

ddx.vs: Acquired pseudo-Pelger cells occur in a minority of neutrophils alongside hypogranulation, cytopenias and other dysplasia, whereas the inherited form affects most neutrophils with normal granulation and blood counts.
Drug-related hypolobation appears after exposure and resolves on withdrawal, often with hypogranularity, and family members are unaffected.

ddx.dx: True left shift with increased band neutrophils
ddx.vs: Genuine bands in infection have less condensed chromatin, often toxic granulation or Dohle bodies, and are accompanied by metamyelocytes.

captions: A: Bilobed pince-nez neutrophil with coarse chromatin
B: Band-like non-segmented neutrophil

exam.answer_en: Inherited Pelger-Huët anomaly — bilobed pince-nez and non-segmented neutrophils with coarse mature chromatin and normal granules
pearls_zh: 考法：指著「夾鼻眼鏡」雙葉核中性球，問是真性 Pelger-Huët 還是 pseudo-Pelger；線索是家族性、健康成人、大多數中性球皆受影響且顆粒正常。
遺傳：heterozygous LBR（lamin B receptor）變異，體染色體顯性；同型合子時中性球核幾乎呈圓形，並可合併骨骼發育異常。
臨床意義：良性，中性球功能正常，不需治療；重點是避免被誤判為 left shift（感染）而過度治療或誤判為 MDS 而做骨髓檢查。
pseudo-Pelger-Huët 常見於 MDS、AML 與藥物（如 mycophenolate、taxanes、valproate），通常只影響部分中性球且常伴隨低顆粒化等其他 dysplasia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤當成感染的 band 增多（left shift）或 MDS 的 pseudo-Pelger；真性 PHA 染色質高度凝集、顆粒正常、幾乎全部中性球受影響且有家族史。

quiz.q: 這些雙葉「夾鼻眼鏡」狀中性球出現在健康父子身上，診斷與致病基因為何？

13037.recognize_zh: 紅色箭頭所指的多顆紅血球內各含一個小而圓、深紫色、偏心的點狀包涵體，即 Howell-Jolly 小體（核殘留），數量多時代表脾功能低下，此例與慢性移植物抗宿主病（cGVHD）造成的功能性無脾有關。
features: Multiple red cells containing a single small, round, dense purple inclusion (Howell-Jolly bodies), marked by arrows
One larger bluish (polychromatophilic) red cell also contains a Howell-Jolly body
Scattered echinocytes/crenated red cells and occasional target-like cells
Red cells otherwise largely normocytic with central pallor
Few platelets; no leukocytes in this field
13037.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with numerous Howell-Jolly bodies, appearing as single small, round, dense basophilic inclusions within red cells, including one in a polychromatophilic cell. Scattered crenated red cells are also present. No schistocytes, parasites, or nucleated red cells are seen in this field. Frequent Howell-Jolly bodies indicate hyposplenism, and in this clinical setting are consistent with functional asplenia related to chronic graft-versus-host disease, conferring increased risk of infection with encapsulated organisms.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple, smaller, irregular granules clustered at the cell periphery and stain with Prussian blue, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are single, round and larger.
Parasites show a cytoplasmic ring with a chromatin dot rather than a solid dense sphere.
An overlying platelet is larger, granular, and has a surrounding halo, and it lies in a different focal plane.
Stippling appears as numerous fine dots dispersed throughout the red cell rather than one discrete round body.

exam.answer_en: Hyposplenism (functional asplenia from chronic GVHD) — numerous Howell-Jolly bodies in red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指紅血球內單顆、圓形、深紫色的點，問名稱與意義；Howell-Jolly body 是 DNA 核殘留（Feulgen 陽性），正常由脾臟清除，數量多即代表脾功能低下。
原因要能列舉：脾切除、sickle cell disease 自體脾梗塞、慢性 GVHD、celiac disease、脾臟放射或浸潤；巨母細胞性貧血也可見 HJ body。
臨床意義：功能性無脾易受 encapsulated organisms（S. pneumoniae、H. influenzae type b、N. meningitidis）引起猛爆性感染，需依指引補疫苗並教育發燒即就醫。
脾功能低下的其他抹片線索：target cells、acanthocytes、Pappenheimer bodies、血小板偏高。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Pappenheimer bodies：後者為多顆細小、成簇、位於周邊，且 Prussian blue（鐵染）陽性；HJ body 通常單顆較大且鐵染陰性。也要排除血小板疊在紅血球上（周圍常有淡暈）。

quiz.q: 紅色箭頭所指紅血球內的包涵體叫什麼？大量出現代表何種器官功能異常？

4141.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆遠大於周圍細胞的巨大細胞，單一多分葉核相連聚在一側，細胞質豐富、呈細緻淡紫色顆粒狀，是正常成熟巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of surrounding hematopoietic cells
Low N:C ratio with a single multilobulated nucleus whose lobes remain connected
Coarse, clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Abundant cytoplasm with fine, evenly distributed azurophilic (lilac) granules
Surrounding granulocytic and erythroid precursors and red cells
4141.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large mature megakaryocyte with a single, connected multilobulated nucleus with clumped chromatin and abundant finely granular lilac cytoplasm. It is surrounded by maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. There is no nuclear hypolobation, separation of lobes or abnormal cytoplasmic maturation. Findings are consistent with a normal mature megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, uniform round nuclei with nucleoli and coarser pink-purple granules, rather than one connected lobulated nucleus.
Dysplastic forms show multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes (pawn-ball) instead of the contiguous lobulated nucleus seen here.
Tumor giant cells are pleomorphic with prominent nucleoli and non-granular cytoplasm, often in cohesive clusters.

exam.answer_en: Normal mature megakaryocyte — very large cell with a single connected multilobulated nucleus and abundant finely granular cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指視野中最大的細胞，問名稱與「正常或異常」；判讀重點是核葉相連為單一核、胞質成熟有細顆粒，無低分葉或核葉分離。
生物學：megakaryocyte 經 endomitosis 形成多倍體（可達 16N–64N），受 thrombopoietin 經 MPL 受體調控；胞質碎裂釋出血小板。
異常型態對應疾病：micromegakaryocyte、核葉分離（MDS）；單葉/低分葉（MDS with isolated del(5q)）；大型過度分葉 staghorn（ET）；雲朵狀、深染、成群異型（PMF）。
Emperipolesis（其他血球穿行於胞質中）可見於正常或反應性巨核細胞，本身不代表腫瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 osteoclast 混淆：osteoclast 為多個彼此分離、大小相近的圓核且胞質粗顆粒；megakaryocyte 為單一相連的多葉核。轉移腫瘤巨細胞則有異型核與成群黏合。

quiz.q: 圖中這顆最大的細胞是什麼？若其核呈多個分離圓核、大小一致，應改想哪一種細胞？

3693.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結可見多個具淡染生發中心與深染外套層的反應性濾泡，濾泡間區散布許多小片淡粉紅色類上皮組織球群，濾泡增生加上小型類上皮組織球群提示弓漿蟲淋巴結炎。
features: Low-power view of lymph node with enlarged reactive follicles showing pale germinal centers and well-defined dark mantle zones
Numerous small, pale eosinophilic clusters of epithelioid histiocytes scattered in the interfollicular and perifollicular areas
Epithelioid clusters are small and loose, without formation of well-circumscribed granulomas
Paler interfollicular areas with scattered vessels, possibly representing monocytoid B-cell zones
No necrosis or giant cells evident at this magnification
3693.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows reactive follicular hyperplasia with polarized germinal centers and intact mantle zones. Numerous small, loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are scattered in the interfollicular regions and abut the follicles, without well-formed granulomas or necrosis. Paler interfollicular zones may represent monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia, which is better assessed at higher power. Findings are consistent with the pattern of toxoplasma lymphadenitis; confirm serologically.

ddx.vs: Sarcoidosis shows discrete, well-circumscribed non-necrotizing granulomas with giant cells, often effacing the node, rather than tiny loose epithelioid clusters with florid follicles.
Follicular lymphoma shows crowded follicles lacking mantles and tingible body macrophages, with BCL2-positive germinal centers.
Lennert lymphoma has confluent epithelioid clusters in a diffuse atypical T-cell infiltrate that effaces the architecture, rather than preserved reactive follicles.

exam.answer_en: Toxoplasma lymphadenitis (low power) — florid reactive follicular hyperplasia with small interfollicular clusters of epithelioid histiocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍圖考「結構判讀」：考官問濾泡是反應性還是腫瘤性，並指濾泡間淡粉紅小片，問是什麼細胞、組合起來指向哪個診斷。
Piringer-Kuchinka 三聯徵：(1) 明顯濾泡增生 (2) 小群類上皮組織球散布並侵入生發中心邊緣 (3) 淋巴竇內 monocytoid B cell 增生；三者合併高度提示弓漿蟲淋巴結炎。
確診靠血清學：Toxoplasma IgM/IgG，必要時加做 IgG avidity 判斷感染時間；切片中罕見蟲體，IHC 或 PCR 陽性率低，形態只能「提示」。
反應性濾泡特徵：大小形狀不一、生發中心極性（明暗區）、有 tingible body macrophages、外套層完整；必要時 BCL2 IHC 生發中心陰性支持反應性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 follicular lymphoma：FL 濾泡密集背靠背、大小一致、缺乏極性與 tingible body macrophages，生發中心 BCL2+；本圖濾泡具反應性特徵且有類上皮組織球小群。

quiz.q: 此低倍淋巴結圖的濾泡為反應性或腫瘤性？濾泡間的淡粉紅小細胞群提示哪種診斷？
quiz.a: 反應性濾泡增生；類上皮組織球小群提示 Toxoplasma lymphadenitis。

1197.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖：左圖 FS/SS 顯示低側向散射的細胞群；右圖 CD45 對 SS 中，紅色 A 閘為 CD45 弱表現、低 SS 的母細胞群，藍色 B 閘為 CD45 強表現的淋巴球，顯示一群明顯的母細胞，須再以系列標記判定 T／骨髓混合表現型。
features: Left plot: forward scatter versus side scatter with a large population of low-SSC, low-to-intermediate FSC events (red) and a slightly smaller low-FSC population (blue)
Right plot: CD45-PC7 versus side scatter with gate A (red) containing CD45-dim, low-SSC blasts
Gate B (blue) containing CD45-bright, low-SSC lymphocytes
Relatively few high-SSC CD45-positive granulocytic events, indicating blasts dominate the sample
Lineage-defining markers (CD3, MPO) are not shown in this figure
1197.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis shows, on forward versus side scatter, a predominant population of events with low side scatter and low-to-intermediate forward scatter. On CD45 versus side scatter gating, the dominant population (gate A, red) shows dim CD45 expression and low side scatter, characteristic of blasts, and is distinct from a smaller CD45-bright lymphocyte population (gate B, blue). Maturing granulocytes with high side scatter are relatively sparse. This gating identifies an expanded blast population but does not establish lineage; assignment of mixed phenotype T/myeloid acute leukemia requires demonstration of cytoplasmic CD3 and MPO (or monocytic differentiation) on the gated blasts.

ddx.dx: T-lymphoblastic leukemia with myeloid antigen expression
ddx.vs: T-ALL can express CD13/CD33 but lacks MPO or monocytic differentiation, so it does not meet mixed phenotype criteria.
AML may express CD7 but lacks cytoplasmic CD3, which is required for T-lineage assignment.
ETP-ALL expresses stem/myeloid markers (CD34, CD117, CD13/33) with cCD3 but is MPO-negative.

1773.recognize_zh: 胸水細胞離心抹片中有一個緊密、立體的大型細胞團，由大小相近的圓形小細胞緊密堆疊組成、細胞邊界清楚，與周圍零散的間皮細胞或巨噬細胞明顯不同；在兒童病人出現這種小圓細胞團，需考慮轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Large, tightly cohesive three-dimensional cluster of uniform small round cells
Cells are closely packed with distinct cell membranes and mutual molding
Round nuclei with fine to smudgy chromatin; nuclear detail obscured by cluster thickness
Scant to moderate pale cytoplasm, some cells with fine punctate vacuoles or granules
Clean background with a few isolated histiocytes/mesothelial cells; no clear Homer Wright rosettes or neuropil in this field
1773.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid shows a large, tightly cohesive three-dimensional cluster of uniform small round cells with distinct cell borders and nuclear molding, in a clean background with a few isolated histiocytes. Nuclear chromatin detail is partly obscured by the thickness of the cluster, and rosettes or neurofibrillary matrix are not clearly seen. The presence of cohesive clusters of small round cells foreign to the serous fluid indicates malignant effusion; in a child, this is consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma, which should be confirmed by immunocytochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin, chromogranin; CD45-negative) and urine catecholamines.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells are larger with dense two-tone cytoplasm, 'windows' between cells and a peripheral lacy skirt, and are calretinin-positive.
Blasts are discohesive single cells rather than cohesive molded clusters and are CD45 and TdT positive.

ddx.dx: Other small round blue cell tumors (Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, Wilms)
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; separated by CD99/NKX2-2, desmin/myogenin, or WT1 immunostains and molecular studies.

1965.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片箭頭處為圓核、染色質較細的細胞，胞質充滿粗大橘褐色嗜伊紅顆粒並夾雜少量暗色顆粒，這是嗜伊紅性骨髓細胞（eosinophilic myelocyte）；對照旁邊顆粒細小的嗜中性前驅細胞可看出差異。
features: Arrowed cell with a round, eccentric nucleus and moderately condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm filled with coarse, refractile orange-brown eosinophilic granules with some darker granules
Cell size similar to adjacent neutrophilic myelocytes
Surrounding promyelocytes/myelocytes, a band neutrophil, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
Background of red cells and scattered vacuole artifacts
1965.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixture of granulocytic and erythroid precursors. The arrowed cell has a round eccentric nucleus and cytoplasm packed with coarse orange-brown eosinophilic granules with a few darker granules, identifying it as an eosinophilic myelocyte. Neighboring neutrophilic promyelocytes and myelocytes contain finer, less refractile granules. This image illustrates normal eosinophilic precursor morphology rather than a specific disease.

ddx.vs: Has a larger nucleus with a Golgi zone and fine azurophilic purple granules rather than coarse orange refractile granules.
