Contains coarse dark blue-black granules that overlie the nucleus rather than orange-pink granules.
Larger cell with dense dark metachromatic granules and a central round nucleus, often in particles.

4845.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中嗜中性球細胞質內可見一顆亮藍綠色、邊界清楚的折光性包涵體（green neutrophil inclusion），背景紅血球有許多靶形紅血球（target cells），符合肝病相關的綠色包涵體。
features: Mature segmented neutrophils with normal lobulation and fine pinkish granules
Single bright blue-green, sharply defined, refractile cytoplasmic inclusion
Inclusion distinct from normal granules and not associated with vacuolization or bacteria
Numerous target cells in the red cell background
No toxic granulation or Döhle bodies evident
4845.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two closely apposed mature segmented neutrophils; one contains a single bright blue-green, sharply defined, refractile cytoplasmic inclusion that is distinct from the normal neutrophilic granules. No vacuolization, Döhle bodies or intracellular organisms are present. The red cells show numerous target cells. Findings are consistent with green neutrophil inclusions, which are believed to represent lipofuscin-like bile pigment material and are associated with acute liver injury or lactic acidosis and a poor prognosis.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale blue-gray, poorly defined patches at the cytoplasmic periphery, not bright green refractile inclusions.
Organisms appear as uniform rods, cocci or yeast forms, often with vacuoles, rather than a single glassy green crystal-like inclusion.
May-Hegglin inclusions are larger pale blue spindle-shaped bodies and are accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Precipitate is in a different plane, often also present over red cells and background, whereas a true inclusion lies within the cytoplasm in the same focal plane.

1261.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆嗜中性球的核只分成兩葉、以細橋相連，呈眼鏡狀（pince-nez），染色質粗而高度凝集，細胞質有正常顆粒，符合 Pelger-Huët 核型異常。
features: Neutrophil of normal size with a bilobed nucleus
Two round nuclear lobes joined by a short thin bridge (pince-nez/spectacle configuration)
Very coarse, densely clumped chromatin indicating nuclear maturity
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine specific granules and a few small vacuoles
Background of normochromic red cells and scattered platelets
1261.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus in which two rounded lobes are connected by a thin chromatin bridge, forming a pince-nez configuration. The chromatin is coarse and densely clumped, and the cytoplasm contains fine granules with a few small vacuoles. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with a Pelger-Huët anomaly neutrophil; distinction between the inherited anomaly and acquired (pseudo-Pelger-Huët) change depends on whether most neutrophils are affected, family history, drug exposure and the presence of other dysplastic features.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly (MDS, AML, drugs such as mycophenolate or tacrolimus)
ddx.vs: Acquired forms usually affect only a subset of neutrophils and often show hypogranular cytoplasm and other dysplasia, whereas inherited PHA affects nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation.
Band nuclei are C- or U-shaped of uniform width with less condensed chromatin, not two discrete round lobes with a thin filament.
Eosinophils are also bilobed but have coarse orange-red granules filling the cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Pelger-Huët anomaly — mature neutrophil with bilobed pince-nez (spectacle) nucleus and coarsely clumped chromatin
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著這顆雙葉眼鏡狀核的中性球，問「這是什麼？」以及「遺傳性或後天性怎麼分？」。
遺傳性 Pelger-Huët：LBR（lamin B receptor）基因突變，體染色體顯性；heterozygote 大多數中性球呈雙葉，功能正常、無臨床症狀；homozygote 核多為圓形不分葉。
後天性 pseudo-Pelger-Huët 常見於 MDS、AML（dysgranulopoiesis 的表現），也可見於藥物（如 mycophenolate、tacrolimus、taxane 類）；常合併 hypogranulation。
判斷重點：遺傳性者幾乎所有中性球受影響、無其他 dysplasia、家族成員同樣表現；後天性者比例較不一致並伴其他系列 dysplasia 或血球減少。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被誤認為 band neutrophil 而誤判為左移感染；Pelger-Huët 的染色質高度凝集成熟，band 核染色質較細且呈彎曲帶狀未凝集成兩個圓葉。

quiz.q: 若家族中多人所有中性球都呈圖中這種雙葉眼鏡狀核且無症狀，最可能的致病基因是？
quiz.a: LBR（lamin B receptor），體染色體顯性遺傳

1069.recognize_zh: 兩個中性球細胞質中有較粗的紫紅色毒性顆粒，左側分節中性球細胞質邊緣隱約可見淡藍色小斑（Döhle 小體）；但此倍率下 Döhle 小體不清楚，辨識需放大確認。
features: Segmented and band neutrophils with coarse purple cytoplasmic granulation (toxic granulation)
Possible faint pale blue peripheral cytoplasmic patch in the left neutrophil (Döhle body), poorly resolved at this magnification
Scattered polychromatophilic red cells
Occasional elongated/irregular red cells; platelets present
1069.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil and a band neutrophil with coarse cytoplasmic granulation. A faint pale blue peripheral cytoplasmic inclusion suggestive of a Döhle body may be present, but it is not well resolved at this magnification. The red cells are largely normocytic with a few polychromatophilic cells, and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with reactive neutrophil changes such as toxic granulation, supporting an infectious or inflammatory process.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger and crisper, involve most neutrophils and occur with giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Normal neutrophils have fine, lilac-pink granules, whereas toxic granules are coarse and dark purple-blue.
Alder-Reilly granules are large, dark and present in all leukocytes, including lymphocytes and monocytes, independent of infection.

1133.recognize_zh: 視野左上方一顆巨大的漿細胞含四個圓形細胞核，細胞質深藍色並有核周淡染區，周圍另有多顆核偏位的漿細胞，符合多發性骨髓瘤中的多核漿細胞。
features: Large plasma cell with four round nuclei of similar size and abundant deep blue cytoplasm
Nuclei with coarse chromatin and faint nucleoli; perinuclear pale zone
Numerous additional plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Some plasma cells with dispersed chromatin suggesting immaturity
Background eosinophils/granulocytes, a small lymphocyte, and red cells
1133.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, and basophilic cytoplasm. A large multinucleated plasma cell containing four round nuclei with faint nucleoli is present at the upper left. Scattered granulocytes, eosinophils, and a lymphocyte are also seen. Multinucleated and atypical plasma cells of this type support a neoplastic plasma cell proliferation; findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts are much larger with many (often more than 10) uniform nuclei, abundant granular cytoplasm, and no perinuclear hof.
Megakaryocytes show a lobulated connected nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm with platelet budding, rather than separate round nuclei with a hof.
Reactive plasmacytosis may contain occasional binucleate cells but rarely tetranucleate forms, and plasma cells are polytypic.

4205.recognize_zh: 脾臟高倍H&E中為多形性淋巴樣細胞浸潤，混有核大、核仁明顯的免疫母細胞（immunoblasts）、漿細胞樣細胞與小淋巴球，細胞大小不一且非單一族群，符合傳染性單核球增多症的反應性變化。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, intermediate cells and large immunoblasts
Immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei and single prominent central nucleoli
Plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm
Occasional mitotic figure
Intervening splenic cords and endothelial cells in the red pulp
4205.describe_en: High-power section of spleen shows the red pulp infiltrated by a polymorphous population of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and numerous immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei and prominent central nucleoli. Occasional mitotic figures are present. The spectrum of cell sizes and maturation argues against a monotonous neoplastic infiltrate. Findings are consistent with the immunoblastic reaction of infectious mononucleosis; EBER in situ hybridization and immunophenotyping help exclude large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows sheets of monotonous large atypical cells effacing architecture, whereas here immunoblasts are admixed with a spectrum of smaller and plasmacytoid cells.
Immunoblasts can mimic Reed-Sternberg cells, but HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+/CD45-negative with weak PAX5, while IM immunoblasts are CD45+ and CD20 or CD3 positive.
PTCL shows atypical cells with irregular nuclei and aberrant T-cell antigen loss with clonal TCR rearrangement.

4077.recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中有數顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色並布滿細纖維狀條紋（揉皺衛生紙樣），核小而偏位，彼此相連成群，是 Gaucher 細胞的特徵。
features: Several large histiocytes several times the size of neighboring granulocytes
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with fine fibrillary striations (crumpled tissue paper)
Small round to oval, eccentric nuclei with condensed chromatin
Cells in a small cluster with indistinct borders
Background maturing myeloid cells, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
4077.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small cluster of large histiocytes with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm displaying fine fibrillary, wrinkled striations and small eccentric nuclei, among maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. The cytoplasm lacks foamy vacuoles or discrete granules. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; glucocerebrosidase enzyme activity and GBA1 mutation analysis are needed to exclude pseudo-Gaucher cells.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma or thalassemia look identical but occur with normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells show foamy soap-bubble vacuoles rather than linear fibrillary striations.
MAC-laden histiocytes can look striated but are AFB positive and occur in immunosuppressed patients.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher disease — clustered Gaucher cells with fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：一群大型組織球問「這是哪一種儲積症細胞？」答 Gaucher cell，堆積物為 glucocerebroside（glucosylceramide）。
組化：PAS 陽性、TRAP 陽性；確診用白血球 glucocerebrosidase 活性與 GBA1 基因檢測。
Type 1 無神經侵犯、最常見；治療有 enzyme replacement（imiglucerase 等）與 substrate reduction（eliglustat 等）。
骨髓大量 Gaucher cells 會造成血球低下；Gaucher 病人罹患 myeloma 與 Parkinson disease 風險上升。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易當成 pseudo-Gaucher cells（CML、thalassemia、myeloma、MAC 感染）；形態無法可靠區分，需臨床與酵素/基因檢測確認。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞胞質的條紋外觀常被比喻為什麼？
quiz.a: Crumpled tissue paper（揉皺的衛生紙）

4013.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒高倍下以紡錘或卵圓核的基質細胞、含棕色含鐵血黃素的巨噬細胞與脂肪空泡為主，只見少數嗜中性球與小型單核細胞，造血細胞明顯減少；慢性 GVHD 相關的低細胞性骨髓只能看到這類非特異性變化。
features: Stromal cells with elongated or oval nuclei within a pale syncytial matrix
Macrophages containing coarse golden-brown hemosiderin pigment
Fat vacuoles of varying size within and around the particle
Few segmented neutrophils and small mononuclear cells; erythroid and megakaryocytic cells not evident
No blasts, granulomas or viral inclusions identified
4013.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at higher power shows a particle composed largely of stromal cells with oval to spindled nuclei, hemosiderin-laden macrophages and fat vacuoles. Hematopoietic cells are sparse, limited to occasional neutrophils and small mononuclear cells, with no identifiable erythroid precursors or megakaryocytes in this field. No blasts or viral inclusions are seen. Findings are consistent with a hypocellular, stroma-rich marrow with increased storage iron; these changes are nonspecific but compatible with marrow hypoplasia in the setting of chronic graft-versus-host disease.

ddx.dx: Graft failure or poor graft function
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; donor chimerism studies distinguish graft failure from immune-mediated hypoplasia.
Heavy transfusion increases macrophage hemosiderin, which may coexist with and contribute to the pigment seen here.
Early post-conditioning aplasia looks similar and is separated only by timing relative to transplant.

3821.recognize_zh: 低倍脾臟切片中央為一個白髓淋巴濾泡，四周紅髓與邊緣區則被大量淡染透亮的泡沫狀組織球群包圍，這種泡沫細胞沿白髓周邊擴張的分布提示 Niemann-Pick 病的脾臟侵犯。
features: Central white pulp lymphoid aggregate (dark blue cluster of small lymphocytes)
Numerous pale, clear foamy histiocyte clusters surrounding the white pulp and throughout red pulp
Red pulp congested with red cells between storage cell clusters
Fibrous trabecula at lower right
No atypical lymphoid expansion or necrosis at this magnification
3821.describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows a central white pulp lymphoid aggregate surrounded by numerous clusters of pale, clear, foamy histiocytes that expand the perifollicular region and extend throughout the congested red pulp. A fibrous trabecula is present at the lower right. No atypical lymphoid infiltrate or necrosis is evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with splenic involvement by a lipid storage disorder, compatible with Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.vs: Gaucher disease also diffusely expands red pulp, but at higher power the storage cells have eosinophilic fibrillary rather than clear foamy cytoplasm.
HCL diffusely infiltrates red pulp with atrophic white pulp and blood lakes, and the infiltrating cells are B cells, not foamy histiocytes.
Other lipidoses show similar foam cells and require clinical, lipid profile, and genetic/enzyme testing for separation.
Artifactual clearing lacks discrete cells with nuclei and cell membranes, whereas these clusters are composed of intact histiocytes.

3757.recognize_zh: 低倍血液抹片中白血球明顯增多，以嗜中性球為主，夾雜帶狀核與較大的未成熟顆粒球及單核樣細胞，呈左移，符合 G-CSF 刺激後的周邊血液反應。
features: Increased leukocytes at low power, predominantly neutrophils
Mixture of segmented and band neutrophils with occasional larger immature granulocytes (left shift)
Several larger mononuclear cells with more abundant cytoplasm
No blasts clearly identifiable at this magnification
Red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; granule detail not resolvable
3757.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows leukocytosis with neutrophil predominance, including band forms and occasional larger immature granulocytes and mononuclear cells. Red cells are normocytic without significant poikilocytosis. Cytoplasmic granulation and Döhle bodies cannot be evaluated at this magnification. In a patient receiving growth factor, findings are consistent with a G-CSF–induced neutrophilic leukocytosis with left shift.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar; history of G-CSF administration versus infectious source is the main discriminator.
CML shows a myelocyte and neutrophil peak with basophilia and eosinophilia, and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
CNL shows persistent mature neutrophilia with less than 10% immature granulocytes and CSF3R mutation without growth factor exposure.

3501.recognize_zh: 一個由三個大型細胞黏聚成的小團，細胞邊界融合、細胞質灰藍，其中一個核被細胞質內的大空泡壓成新月形（類印戒細胞），核染色質粗顆粒狀，與周圍造血細胞明顯不同，符合轉移性腺癌。
features: Small cohesive cluster of three large cells with indistinct shared cell borders
Large nuclei with coarsely granular chromatin and high N:C ratio
Clear cytoplasmic vacuole indenting one nucleus into a crescent (signet-ring-like appearance)
Grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Background red cells; no admixed hematopoietic maturation within the cluster
3501.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small cohesive cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with grey-blue cytoplasm, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, and coarsely granular chromatin. One cell contains a clear cytoplasmic vacuole that indents the nucleus into a crescent shape, imparting a signet-ring-like appearance suggestive of mucin. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma; in the appropriate clinical context this is compatible with colorectal origin, to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (CK20, CDX2, SATB2) on the trephine biopsy.

ddx.vs: Erythroid precursors have deep blue cytoplasm, smaller round nuclei, and are arranged around a central macrophage rather than forming vacuolated cohesive cells.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are dispersed rather than cohesive, and they lack signet-ring mucin vacuoles.
Gastric and colorectal primaries overlap morphologically and require IHC and clinical correlation (e.g., CK7/CK20, CDX2, SATB2) for separation.

3373.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片網狀纖維銀染（reticulin stain，綠色背景）中，骨小樑間充滿密集且大量交錯的黑色纖維，部分纖維粗厚、呈流水狀排列並環繞血管，造血細胞稀少；瀰漫性密集交織的網狀纖維即為骨髓纖維化。
features: Diffuse and dense increase in black-staining reticulin fibers throughout the intertrabecular space
Extensive intersections with focally coarse, thick fibers
Streaming, swirling fiber arrangement and a dilated sinusoid outlined by fibers
Sparse cellularity with scattered cells in a green-counterstained stroma
Bony trabecula at upper right for orientation
3373.describe_en: Reticulin-stained bone marrow biopsy section with green counterstain shows a diffuse and dense increase in black reticulin fibers occupying the intertrabecular space, with extensive intersections and focally coarse, thick fibers. The fibers have a streaming pattern and outline a dilated sinusoid, and hematopoietic cellularity appears reduced. By the WHO/European consensus scale, this corresponds to at least MF-2; distinguishing MF-3 requires a trichrome stain to assess collagen. Findings are consistent with marked bone marrow reticulin fibrosis; the underlying cause (primary or post-PV/ET myelofibrosis, other myeloid neoplasm, hairy cell leukemia, metastatic tumor or reactive process) should be determined from H&E morphology and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: PMF is favored by clusters of atypical megakaryocytes on H&E, leukoerythroblastosis and a JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation.
HCL causes a fine reticulin meshwork around individual CD20+ interstitial cells and presents with pancytopenia and BRAF V600E.
Metastatic tumor shows cytokeratin-positive cohesive cells within the fibrotic stroma.

ddx.dx: Acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis or acute megakaryoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: These show increased CD34+ blasts and atypical megakaryocytes with an acute clinical onset.

exam.answer_en: Marked bone marrow reticulin fibrosis (at least MF-2) — dense diffuse intersecting reticulin fibers with focal coarse bundles
pearls_zh: 考法：網狀纖維銀染圖，要求依 European consensus（MF-0 至 MF-3）分級，並說出區分 MF-3 需加做 trichrome 評估 collagen。
分級：MF-1 為疏鬆網狀、多處交錯；MF-2 為瀰漫密集且廣泛交錯，可有局部粗纖維束；MF-3 另有粗大 collagen 束，常伴骨硬化。
骨髓纖維化常造成 dry tap，診斷需依賴切片；周邊血常見 leukoerythroblastosis 與 teardrop cells。
病因鑑別：PMF 或 post-PV/ET MF（查 JAK2、CALR、MPL）、hairy cell leukemia、轉移癌、acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 血管周圍與骨小樑旁本來就有較多網狀纖維，把這些區域算入會高估分級；應選造血區判讀，並注意切片厚度與染色強度造成的誤差。

quiz.q: 此網狀纖維染色至少屬於哪一級？要判定更高級別需加做什麼染色？
quiz.a: 至少 MF-2；Masson trichrome（評估 collagen）

3245.recognize_zh: 密集而單調的淋巴細胞群，核圓、染色質中度濃縮、細胞質淡藍少量；箭頭所指為染色質較粗塊狀的小淋巴球。但多數細胞比典型 CLL 稍大、部分可見核仁，需考慮 prolymphocyte 比例或抹片厚度的影響。
features: Dense, monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Round to slightly oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Some cells with a small but visible nucleolus (prolymphocyte-like)
Scant to moderate pale-blue cytoplasm
Arrow marks a small lymphocyte with coarse, clumped chromatin; few smudge cells in this field
3245.describe_en: Cellular smear shows a dense, monotonous population of lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant to moderate pale-blue cytoplasm. The arrow indicates a small lymphocyte with coarse, block-like chromatin typical of CLL. However, many cells in this field are somewhat larger than classic CLL cells, and some show small visible nucleoli, raising the possibility of increased prolymphocytes or thick-area artifact. The findings are compatible with chronic lymphocytic leukemia, but the prolymphocyte percentage should be enumerated and mantle cell lymphoma excluded by immunophenotyping.

ddx.dx: CLL with increased prolymphocytes / prolymphocytic progression
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes are larger with a single prominent central nucleolus and more cytoplasm; more than 15% prolymphocytes (CLL/PL) or a predominance suggests progression.
MCL cells are medium-sized with irregular nuclear contours and are CD23- cyclin D1+ SOX11+, whereas CLL is CD23+ with weak CD20 and surface Ig.
These show bright CD20 and surface Ig, usually CD5-, with a majority of nucleolated cells and massive splenomegaly.
Richter cells are large (more than twice a small lymphocyte) with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, forming sheets rather than a population dominated by small cells.

3181.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆中小型淋巴細胞，核極度深染並有多處瘤狀凹凸與分葉，細胞質只剩一圈薄藍邊；左下角另可見一顆分葉明顯的異常細胞核，符合 ATLL 的多分葉核淋巴細胞。
features: Small-to-medium lymphoid cell with very high N:C ratio
Hyperchromatic nucleus with multiple knobby lobulations and indentations
Dense, coarsely condensed chromatin; nucleoli not visible
Very scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Partial view of a second cell with a lobulated nucleus at lower left; normal red cells in background
3181.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small-to-medium atypical lymphoid cell with a hyperchromatic, knobby multilobated nucleus, dense chromatin and only a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm. A second cell with a similarly lobulated nucleus is partially visible at the lower left. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with the polylobated lymphocytes of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, to be correlated with HTLV-1 serology and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Small Sezary cells have a cerebriform nucleus with fine grooves rather than knobby lobation and are HTLV-1 negative.
FL cells usually have a single deep cleft rather than multiple lobes and express CD10, BCL2 and B-cell markers.
Crushed cells show smeared chromatin with indistinct outlines rather than crisp defined lobes surrounded by an intact cytoplasmic rim.
Neutrophils have pink granular cytoplasm and are larger with abundant cytoplasm rather than a thin basophilic rim.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma — small-to-medium lymphocytes with hyperchromatic knobby polylobated nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：細胞較小、胞質極少，考官要你辨認出核的瘤狀多分葉仍是 ATLL 特徵；ATLL 細胞大小變異大，不一定都是典型大 flower cell。
與 Sézary 的免疫表型區分不可靠（兩者皆 CD4+、常 CD7−）；CD25 強表現與 HTLV-1 陽性支持 ATLL。
骨髓侵犯程度通常不如周邊血與器官侵犯明顯；皮膚、淋巴結、肝脾侵犯常見。
預後因子：acute 與 lymphoma 型、高 LDH、低 albumin、高 sIL-2R 預後較差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 follicular lymphoma 的 buttock cell；FL 多為單一深切跡、CD10+ BCL2+ B 細胞，ATLL 是多個分葉的 T 細胞。

quiz.q: 此小至中型淋巴細胞核呈多個瘤狀分葉，最可能屬於哪一種 T 細胞白血病？

3117.recognize_zh: 數顆大型細胞胞質中同時有粗大深紫紅色顆粒與空泡（異常嗜酸性球），旁邊是核摺疊、胞質灰藍的單核球系母細胞，形態提示AML伴inv(16)。
features: Abnormal eosinophilic precursors with large, coarse purple-red granules and several clear vacuoles
Monocytic blasts/promonocytes with folded, lobulated nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Fine chromatin with visible nucleoli in immature cells
Small cell with dark granules (possible basophil) at left
Scattered granular debris in the background
3117.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows immature myelomonocytic cells, including promonocytes with folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm. Several abnormal eosinophilic precursors contain large, coarse purple-red granules with clear cytoplasmic vacuoles. Blast-like cells with fine chromatin and nucleoli are present. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)/t(16;16); CBFB::MYH11.

ddx.vs: Monocytic leukemia lacks the increased abnormal eosinophils with basophilic granules, and CBFB::MYH11 testing is negative.
t(8;21) shows large blasts with salmon-colored granules, long thin Auer rods, and perinuclear hofs, with dysplastic neutrophils rather than monocytic differentiation.
Reactive eosinophils are mature with uniform orange granules and are not accompanied by excess blasts.

exam.answer_en: AML with inv(16); CBFB::MYH11 (AMML with abnormal eosinophils) — promonocytes with folded nuclei plus eosinophil precursors with coarse purple granules
pearls_zh: 考法：這張圖有兩個考點——核摺疊、灰藍胞質的 promonocyte，和含粗大紫紅顆粒的異常嗜酸性前驅細胞；兩者合併就要說 inv(16)。
Promonocyte 在 WHO 與 ICC 中計為 blast equivalent，計算母細胞比例時要納入。
inv(16)/t(16;16) 產生 CBFB::MYH11，為 core-binding factor AML；karyotype 可能漏看，需 FISH 或 RT-PCR 確認。
Flow：myeloid blasts（CD34、CD117）加上單核系分化（CD14、CD64、CD11b）；細胞化學 NSE 陽性並可被 NaF 抑制。
預後相對良好，但 KIT 突變與復發風險增加相關；CBF AML 可考慮加入 gemtuzumab ozogamicin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 t(8;21) AML 混淆，因兩者皆屬 CBF AML；t(8;21) 為大型母細胞、橘紅顆粒、細長 Auer rod 與 hof，無單核分化及異常嗜酸性球。

quiz.q: 圖中核摺疊、胞質灰藍的細胞是什麼？在計算 AML 母細胞比例時是否納入？

2989.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中嗜酸性系細胞與骨髓系前驅細胞含有極粗大、圓形的橘紅色巨大顆粒（左上兩顆最明顯），中央大細胞內也有數顆紫紅色大顆粒，符合 Chediak-Higashi 症候群。
features: Eosinophilic precursors with huge, round orange-red granules markedly larger than normal eosinophilic granules
Myelocytes with coarse, irregular azurophilic giant granules
Central large cell with a few discrete magenta cytoplasmic inclusions
Admixed erythroid precursors with deep blue cytoplasm and lymphocytes
No increase in blasts evident
2989.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population of granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Eosinophilic precursors contain strikingly large, round orange-red granules, and several neutrophilic precursors contain coarse, irregular giant azurophilic granules. A larger central cell shows a few discrete magenta inclusions. Findings are consistent with Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-CH granules are confined to a clonal myeloid population with blasts or dysplasia, not a congenital multilineage abnormality.
Normal eosinophil granules are uniform and small, not the few, huge, variably sized granules seen here.
Alder-Reilly granules are fine and dense in all leukocytes, including lymphocytes, rather than giant fused granules.

exam.answer_en: Chediak-Higashi syndrome — eosinophilic and neutrophilic precursors with huge round orange-red and coarse azurophilic giant granules
pearls_zh: 考法：骨髓圖中最醒目的是左上嗜酸性前驅細胞的巨大圓形橘紅顆粒，考官會問「和正常嗜酸性顆粒差在哪」：數量少、體積巨大、大小不一。
CHS 影響所有含顆粒的細胞系：嗜中性、嗜酸性、單核球、淋巴球、黑色素細胞與血小板。
遺傳：LYST 突變，體染色體隱性；溶酶體相關胞器運輸缺陷。
HLH 為主要致死原因，列於遺傳性 HLH 相關症候群（與 Griscelli syndrome type 2 同屬合併色素異常者）。
根治性治療為 HSCT；但移植無法阻止晚期神經退化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為正常 eosinophilic myelocytes；正常嗜酸性顆粒小而均勻且密布胞質，CHS 顆粒少、巨大、大小不一。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜酸性前驅細胞含巨大圓形橘紅顆粒，與正常嗜酸性顆粒的差別為何？此症候群最主要的致死併發症是什麼？
quiz.a: 顆粒數少、巨大且大小不一；HLH（accelerated phase）

2797.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片被成片的小型淋巴細胞占據，免疫染色只有少數散在的細胞強陽性，絕大多數淋巴細胞為陰性；與 CD3 陽性切片對照，可推論這些淋巴細胞並非 B 細胞，支持 rituximab 後 T 細胞增生（marker 未標示）。
features: Dense, diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells with round to slightly indented nuclei
Nearly all infiltrating lymphocytes are negative for this immunostain
Rare scattered cells show strong brown cytoplasmic staining
Faint granular background staining in interstitial/stromal areas at the left edge
No atypical large cells or aggregates of positive cells identified
2797.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunohistochemical stain (marker not labeled) shows a hypercellular field composed predominantly of small lymphoid cells with round to slightly indented nuclei. The infiltrating lymphocytes are essentially negative, with only rare scattered strongly positive cells and weak nonspecific stromal staining. Assuming a B-cell marker was used, this indicates marked paucity of B cells within the lymphoid infiltrate, supporting a non-B lineage. Findings are suggestive of rituximab-associated marrow T-cell hyperplasia, to be correlated with CD3 staining and clonality studies.

ddx.dx: Residual B-cell lymphoma after anti-CD20 therapy
ddx.vs: Residual lymphoma would show clusters of PAX5 or CD79a-positive B cells despite possible CD20 loss, unlike the near-absent staining here.
PTCL shows cytologic atypia, aberrant T-cell phenotype and clonal TCR rearrangement rather than bland small T cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid aggregates of other causes
ddx.vs: Ordinary reactive aggregates are focal, well-circumscribed and contain a mixture of B and T cells, not a diffuse B-cell-depleted infiltrate.

2797.stain: IHC (marker not labeled; likely B-cell marker)

2733.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中兩顆深藍色細胞質的早期紅血球母細胞，由一條細長的細胞質橋（cytoplasmic bridging）相連，核圓、染色質細顆粒狀；紅血球母細胞間的細胞質橋是紅血球造血異常（dyserythropoiesis）的形態之一。
features: Two basophilic erythroblasts with deeply blue cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing
Thin cytoplasmic bridge connecting the two erythroblasts
Round, eccentric nuclei with finely granular chromatin (megaloblastoid appearance)
Additional intermediate-sized nucleated cells and a partially disrupted cell nearby
Background red cells normochromic with mild anisocytosis
2733.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two basophilic erythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round eccentric nuclei with finely granular, somewhat megaloblastoid chromatin, and a thin cytoplasmic bridge connecting the two cells. Nearby are additional nucleated precursors and a partially disrupted cell. Internuclear or intercytoplasmic bridging between erythroid precursors is a recognized dyserythropoietic feature. Findings are consistent with dyserythropoiesis; this may be reactive (e.g., megaloblastic anemia, drugs, alcohol, HIV) or neoplastic, and requires clinical correlation and assessment of the proportion of dysplastic erythroid cells.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin in hemoglobinized cells, giant metamyelocytes and low B12/folate.
MDS requires dysplasia in at least 10% of erythroid cells with cytopenias and often ring sideroblasts or clonal abnormalities.
CDA I shows prominent internuclear chromatin bridges and spongy heterochromatin in a young patient with lifelong anemia and CDAN1 mutation.
A completing mitosis produces paired cells of identical size joined briefly, and is distinguished by frequency rather than morphology in a single field.

2477.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片顆粒球系增生，可見環狀／帶狀核的中性球、前骨髓細胞、帶粗大顆粒的嗜伊紅性前驅細胞，並夾雜單核球樣細胞與有核紅血球，原始細胞不多；屬骨髓單核球系增生的表現，需配合臨床與基因才支持 JMML。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with myeloid predominance and full granulocytic maturation
Band and ring-shaped neutrophil nuclei, metamyelocytes and myelocytes
Eosinophil precursor with coarse granules (upper right)
Scattered monocytoid cells with folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm
Erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei; blasts not increased in sheets
2477.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with a granulocytic predominance showing maturation through promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms, including ring-shaped nuclei. An eosinophil precursor with coarse granules and scattered monocytoid cells are present, together with erythroid precursors. Blasts are not increased in sheets. The findings indicate a myeloproliferative, myelomonocytic marrow and, in the appropriate pediatric clinical and molecular setting, are consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia; marrow morphology alone is not diagnostic.

ddx.vs: CML shows marked myelocyte-predominant hyperplasia with basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes and is BCR-ABL1 positive.
Reactive marrows show toxic granulation and a clinical infectious source without monocytosis, splenomegaly or clonal RAS-pathway mutation.
AML requires >=20% blasts (plus promonocytes), which are not present in this maturing field.

2413.recognize_zh: 中央那顆大型嗜酸性系細胞的細胞質除了橘紅色顆粒外混有粗大紫色（嗜鹼性）顆粒，旁邊有正常嗜酸球與幾顆芽細胞/單核樣細胞可對照；這種異常嗜酸球是 AML with inv(16) 的招牌表現。
features: Abnormal eosinophil precursor with mixed orange eosinophilic and larger purple-violet basophilic-staining granules
Adjacent mature eosinophil with bilobed nucleus and uniform orange-red granules for comparison
Blasts and myelomonocytic cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm, one with an indented nucleus
Cell with basophilic cytoplasm and coarse dark granules (right), possibly an abnormal eosinophil/basophil precursor
Background with platelets and red cells
2413.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an abnormal eosinophil precursor whose cytoplasm contains a mixture of orange eosinophilic granules and larger purple, basophilic-staining granules, in contrast to an adjacent mature eosinophil with uniform orange granules. Nearby blasts and myelomonocytic cells have high N:C ratios, fine chromatin, indented nuclei, and gray-blue cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with AML with abnormal eosinophils, characteristic of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22); CBFB::MYH11.

ddx.vs: Normal immature eosinophils can show a few purple granules early, but lack the large dark basophilic granules in more mature forms and are not accompanied by increased myelomonocytic blasts.
CML shows separate mature basophils and eosinophils with a left-shifted neutrophilic series and BCR::ABL1, rather than hybrid-granule eosinophils with myelomonocytic blasts.
PDGFRA-associated eosinophilia shows mostly mature eosinophils with mast cell increase, and FIP1L1::PDGFRA rather than CBFB::MYH11 on molecular testing.

exam.answer_en: AML with CBFB::MYH11 (inv(16)/t(16;16)) — abnormal eosinophils with large purple basophilic-staining granules among myelomonocytic blasts
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指混有粗大紫色顆粒的嗜酸性前驅細胞，問其名稱與對應基因；答 abnormal eosinophil，inv(16)(p13.1q22) CBFB::MYH11（FAB M4Eo）。
細胞化學：異常嗜酸球 chloroacetate esterase 呈陽性，正常嗜酸球為陰性，是經典考點。
inv(16) 在傳統核型可能不易看出，需以 FISH 或 RT-PCR 確認；WHO 5th 不設 blast 門檻，ICC 2022 要求 ≥10%。
屬 core-binding factor AML，預後良好；KIT 突變常伴隨並與較高復發相關；鞏固治療以 high-dose cytarabine 為主，可用 RT-qPCR 追蹤 MRD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性嗜酸球增多或 CML：inv(16) 的異常顆粒是在同一顆嗜酸性前驅細胞內混合出現，並伴隨增加的骨髓單核系芽細胞，而非分開的成熟嗜酸/嗜鹼球。

quiz.q: 圖中央這顆含紫色粗顆粒的嗜酸性細胞，提示哪一個重現性基因異常？

2349.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆巨大細胞，淡紫灰色顆粒狀細胞質內含多個彼此分離、大小不一的圓形核葉（separated nuclear lobes，類似 pawn-ball），周圍是小型有核細胞，符合發育異常巨核細胞。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of surrounding nucleated cells
Multiple round, discrete, widely separated nuclear lobes of varying size rather than a single hyperlobulated nucleus
Abundant finely granular lilac-gray cytoplasm with a well-defined border
Surrounding small nucleated cells with dense round nuclei
Thick proteinaceous/blood background in the aspirate smear
2349.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered small nucleated cells in a thick proteinaceous background. A large megakaryocyte is present with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and multiple discrete, widely separated round nuclear lobes of varying size, rather than the normally interconnected lobulated nucleus. No platelet budding is evident. Findings represent a dysplastic megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes, which in the appropriate context is compatible with an MPN, unclassifiable, although this single cell is not diagnostic in isolation.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have many uniform, evenly spaced oval nuclei each with a nucleolus and more irregular, coarsely granular cytoplasm, whereas this cell has lobes of unequal size clustered centrally.
Normal megakaryocyte lobes remain connected in a compact, overlapping nucleus rather than forming separate round nuclei.

ddx.dx: MDS-type dysplastic megakaryocyte (e.g., MDS with del(5q))
ddx.vs: Del(5q) megakaryocytes are small with mono- or hypolobated nuclei, and micromegakaryocytes are small, unlike this large multinucleate cell.
Tumor giant cells show coarse chromatin, prominent nucleoli and cohesive tumor clusters, and lack platelet-type granular cytoplasm.

2029.recognize_zh: kappa 輕鏈免疫組織化學染色：大多數細胞的細胞質呈強烈棕色陽性，核被擠到一側、呈漿細胞樣（plasmacytoid）；需與同區 lambda 染色（僅背景染色）對照，才能判定 kappa 單株性（light chain restriction）。
features: Immunoperoxidase stain for kappa light chain with hematoxylin counterstain
Strong granular cytoplasmic brown staining in the majority of cells
Positive cells are plasmacytoid with eccentric round nuclei
Admixed larger atypical cells with vesicular nuclei, some positive and some negative
Diffuse sheet-like distribution of positive cells
2029.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for kappa light chain shows strong cytoplasmic staining in the majority of the infiltrating cells, which are plasmacytoid with eccentric nuclei; scattered larger cells with vesicular nuclei are also present. When compared with the paired lambda stain showing only background staining, the plasma cells are kappa light chain restricted. Findings support a clonal plasma cell proliferation in the setting of post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a mixture of kappa- and lambda-positive cells, typically at a kappa:lambda ratio of about 2:1, rather than near-exclusive kappa expression.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma or plasmacytoma in a transplant recipient
ddx.vs: Morphology and light chain restriction overlap; association with EBV positivity, the transplant setting, and absence of CRAB features or a pre-existing M-protein favor plasmacytoma-like PTLD.
Serum-related staining is extracellular and interstitial, whereas true positivity here is crisp and intracytoplasmic within plasma cells.

1901.recognize_zh: 打開的腸道黏膜面布滿數十至上百顆大小不一、黃褐色、圓形平滑的息肉狀結節，沿著黏膜皺襞分布，即淋巴瘤性息肉症（multiple lymphomatous polyposis），是套細胞淋巴瘤侵犯腸胃道的典型大體表現。
features: Gross photograph of an opened segment of bowel with ruler for scale
Innumerable sessile, smooth, dome-shaped polypoid nodules on the mucosa
Nodules vary from a few millimeters to about 1 cm
Nodules distributed along preserved mucosal folds, clustered in some segments
No ulcerated mass or stricture evident
1901.describe_en: Gross photograph shows an opened segment of intestine whose mucosal surface is studded by innumerable smooth, sessile, dome-shaped polypoid nodules ranging from a few millimeters to about 1 cm. The nodules are distributed along the mucosal folds without a dominant ulcerated mass. This appearance is that of multiple lymphomatous polyposis. Findings are consistent with gastrointestinal involvement by mantle cell lymphoma, which requires histologic confirmation with cyclin D1 immunostaining.

ddx.vs: FAP polyps are adenomatous with a granular/lobulated surface and dysplastic epithelium on histology, whereas lymphomatous polyps are covered by intact mucosa overlying a lymphoid infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma or MALT lymphoma with polyposis
ddx.vs: Other lymphomas can produce polyposis, so distinction requires immunohistochemistry: MCL is CD5/cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, FL is CD10/BCL2 positive and MALT is CD5/CD10 negative.
Reactive nodules are small and uniform with polarized germinal centers and polytypic B cells, often associated with immunodeficiency, and lack cyclin D1.

exam.answer_en: Mantle cell lymphoma with multiple lymphomatous polyposis — innumerable smooth sessile mucosal polyps along the intestine (gross)
pearls_zh: 考法：大體照問「腸黏膜多發平滑息肉狀結節叫什麼？最典型哪種淋巴瘤？」答：multiple lymphomatous polyposis；mantle cell lymphoma。
IHC：CD20+、CD5+、cyclin D1+、SOX11+，CD10 陰性、CD23 陰性；cyclin D1 陰性的 MCL 可靠 SOX11 與 CCND2 重排輔助診斷。
遺傳：t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH；TP53 突變、blastoid/pleomorphic 型與 Ki-67 高為不良預後因子。
臨床：MCL 腸胃道侵犯很常見，即使無症狀，內視鏡隨機切片也常可發現；多發息肉亦可見於 FL 與 MALT lymphoma，需 IHC 區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 familial adenomatous polyposis：FAP 息肉為腺瘤、表面顆粒狀且上皮有 dysplasia；淋巴瘤性息肉表面黏膜完整，病灶位於黏膜下淋巴浸潤，需切片確認。

quiz.q: 此大體表現最典型的淋巴瘤，其特徵性染色體轉位為何？

1709.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見各階段成熟中的顆粒球（箭頭所指為帶狀核與分葉核中性球、後骨髓球），細胞質帶淡紫色顆粒，旁邊還有深藍色細胞質的早期母紅血球與中晚期母紅血球，呈現正常骨髓的多系列、依序成熟樣貌。
features: Mixed population of hematopoietic cells at different stages of maturation
Maturing granulocytes (arrows): metamyelocytes, band forms, and segmented neutrophils with fine lilac granules
Myelocytes with round eccentric nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Early erythroid precursor with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nucleus (upper left) and later normoblasts with dense nuclei
No increase in blasts evident in this field; image is low resolution with pixelation limiting fine chromatin detail
1709.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population of granulocytic precursors in orderly maturation, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band forms, and segmented neutrophils (arrows), with normal-appearing granulation. Erythroid precursors, including an early basophilic normoblast and later normoblasts with condensed nuclei, are also present. No increase in blasts or obvious dysplasia is identified, although resolution limits fine detail. Findings are consistent with normal trilineage-appearing bone marrow with orderly granulocytic and erythroid maturation in this field.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow shows an increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio with toxic granulation and a shift toward immature forms, which requires a full differential count to assess.
CML marrow is markedly hypercellular with a myelocyte-predominant bulge, increased basophils and eosinophils, and small hypolobated megakaryocytes.
MDS shows dysplasia such as hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and megaloblastoid or multinucleated erythroid precursors, which are not evident here.

1645.recognize_zh: Giemsa 染色（整片偏藍）的淋巴組織，以深藍小淋巴球為主，夾雜核較大、染色質開放的細胞與含空泡碎片的巨噬細胞；右側可見一顆含洋紅色異染顆粒的肥大細胞（mast cell），是正常淋巴組織的 Giemsa 表現。
features: Predominance of small round lymphocytes with dense dark blue nuclei
Admixed larger cells with vesicular nuclei and pale blue cytoplasm
Scattered macrophages with clear cytoplasm containing nuclear debris
A cell with magenta metachromatic cytoplasmic granules at the right edge (mast cell)
No sheets of blasts or monotonous atypical cells
1645.describe_en: Giemsa-stained section of lymphoid tissue shows a mixed population dominated by small round lymphocytes, with interspersed larger cells with vesicular nuclei and scattered macrophages containing apoptotic debris. A cell with metachromatic magenta granules consistent with a mast cell is present at the right edge. The Giemsa stain accentuates nuclear detail and cytoplasmic basophilia but the exact anatomic compartment cannot be determined from this field. Findings are consistent with normal/reactive lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: LPL shows numerous plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and often increased mast cells, rather than the mixed normal population here.
Burkitt lymphoma shows sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with basophilic cytoplasm and a starry-sky pattern, whereas the lymphocytes here are heterogeneous and mostly small.

1517.recognize_zh: 這是血清免疫固定電泳（IFE，非型態圖）：SP 泳道 gamma 區有一條限制性帶（箭頭），同一位置在 G 與 κ 泳道出現濃密窄帶，λ 泳道只有淡而瀰漫的多株背景，判讀為 IgG κ 單株免疫球蛋白。
features: Serum immunofixation electrophoresis gel with lanes SP (total protein), G, A, M, kappa and lambda; cathode at top, anode at bottom
SP lane shows a restricted band in the gamma region (arrows) above the albumin band
Dense, restricted band in the IgG lane at the same migration position as the arrow
Matching dense band in the kappa lane; lambda lane shows only faint diffuse staining
IgA lane shows a faint narrow band at a different, more anodal position; IgM lane is essentially blank
1517.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic laboratory image: serum protein immunofixation electrophoresis. The total protein (SP) lane shows a restricted band in the gamma region (arrows), which co-migrates with a dense restricted band in the anti-IgG lane and in the anti-kappa lane, while the lambda lane shows only faint diffuse polyclonal staining. A faint narrow band in the IgA lane migrates at a different position and does not correspond to the arrowed paraprotein; its significance cannot be determined from this image alone. The pattern indicates an IgG kappa monoclonal protein, supporting the stated diagnosis of multiple myeloma in conjunction with marrow plasma cell burden and end-organ damage.

exam.answer_en: Serum immunofixation electrophoresis: monoclonal IgG kappa paraprotein (restricted band in G and κ lanes)
pearls_zh: 讀圖：先看 SP 泳道找限制性窄帶，再找同位置出現窄帶的 heavy chain 泳道（G/A/M）與 light chain 泳道（κ/λ），兩者對齊即為單株成分類型。
IFE 用於定性（分型）且比 SPEP 敏感；定量 M-protein 則以 SPEP 密度計測量，兩者需搭配 serum free light chain assay。
若只見 κ 或 λ 窄帶而無 G/A/M 對應，需考慮 light chain only myeloma，或補做 IgD/IgE 泳道。
Daratumumab（IgG κ 單株抗體）可在 IFE 形成 IgG κ 帶而干擾判讀 CR，必要時使用 anti-daratumumab 移除試驗。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把多株性 gamma 區瀰漫性增加誤判為單株；單株為窄而清楚的帶且只配對單一輕鏈，多株則為寬帶且 κ 與 λ 皆瀰漫。

quiz.q: 此 IFE 判讀的單株免疫球蛋白類型為何？

61933.recognize_zh: 中央大細胞有摺疊、不規則的核與較細緻的染色質，外圍是大量灰藍色細胞質並有數個小空泡，這是成熟單核球（monocyte）的樣貌。
features: Large cell, about twice the diameter of surrounding red cells
Folded, irregularly lobulated nucleus with moderately condensed, lacy chromatin and no nucleoli
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with a smooth to slightly irregular border
Several small, sharply punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles, mainly adjacent to the nucleus
Background normocytic red cells and a few platelets
61933.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells and scattered platelets. A large mononuclear cell in the center has a folded, irregular nucleus with lacy but mature chromatin, no visible nucleoli, and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm containing several small vacuoles. There are no Auer rods, cytoplasmic basophilia or blast-like chromatin. Findings are consistent with a normal mature monocyte.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have finer, more open chromatin, often a visible nucleolus and a more delicately folded nucleus, and are counted as blast equivalents.
Reactive lymphocytes have denser chromatin, a rounder nucleus and cytoplasm with peripheral basophilia that scallops around red cells rather than grey vacuolated cytoplasm.
Band neutrophils have pink cytoplasm with fine specific granules and a C- or S-shaped nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin.

exam.answer_en: Normal monocyte — folded irregular nucleus, fine chromatin, abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with small vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會問空泡代表什麼；成熟單核球可有少數小空泡屬正常，不必寫成吞噬或 toxic change。
細胞化學與 flow：nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate）陽性且可被 NaF 抑制；成熟單核球 CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD36 陽性。
Monocyte vs promonocyte：promonocyte 核摺疊較纖細、染色質更細緻可有核仁，胞質較嗜鹼性；在 AML/CMML 中 promonocyte 計為 blast equivalent。
CMML 門檻（WHO 5th / ICC 2022）：持續性 monocyte ≥0.5×10^9/L 且佔白血球 ≥10%；考試常以單核球計數切入。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 promonocyte 而過度診斷白血病；成熟單核球染色質較凝集、核摺疊明顯，無核仁。

quiz.q: 此細胞是什麼？在 CMML 計數芽細胞時它是否算入 blast equivalent？

60397.recognize_zh: 這顆細胞的核呈未分節的 C/S 形帶狀（凹陷超過核寬度的一半、各處粗細相近），染色質濃縮，細胞質含細小特異顆粒，符合帶狀嗜中性球（band neutrophil）。
features: Granulocyte about 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Unsegmented, deeply indented C- to S-shaped nucleus of fairly uniform width
Condensed chromatin without nucleoli; no thin filament separating lobes
Pale cytoplasm with abundant fine specific granules
Normocytic red cells in the background
60397.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a curved, band-like nucleus. The nucleus is deeply indented (more than half its width) into a C/S configuration of relatively uniform thickness without filamentous constrictions, the chromatin is condensed, and the cytoplasm contains fine specific granules. No toxic changes are evident. Findings are consistent with a band neutrophil.

ddx.vs: Metamyelocytes have a kidney-shaped nucleus whose indentation is less than half the nuclear width, whereas this nucleus is deeply curved.
Segmented neutrophils show distinct lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments, which are not present here.
Pelger-Huët cells have bilobed (pince-nez) or round nuclei with very coarse chromatin involving most neutrophils, not a C-shaped band.

exam.answer_en: Band neutrophil — unsegmented, deeply indented C/S-shaped nucleus of uniform width without filaments, condensed chromatin
pearls_zh: 考法：考官要你從 metamyelocyte、band、seg 三者中選出這顆，依據是核凹陷超過核寬一半且無細絲相連。
Band 與 seg 的界線：有細絲（寬度明顯小於葉寬）相連才算分葉；只是變窄但仍有可見染色質帶者仍為 band。
Band 增加常見於急性細菌感染，但單獨 band count 對診斷敏感度與特異度有限，需結合臨床與總白血球數。
Pelger-Huët 的 pince-nez（夾鼻眼鏡形）雙葉核或圓核合併粗染色質，影響大多數嗜中性球，與單顆 band 不同。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 metamyelocyte 混淆：metamyelocyte 為腎形核、凹陷不到核寬一半；band 凹陷深、呈 C/S 形且各處粗細相近。

quiz.q: 判定這顆細胞為 band 而非 metamyelocyte 的核形標準是什麼？
quiz.a: 核凹陷超過（假想圓形核）寬度的一半，呈寬度一致的 C/S 形

109.recognize_zh: 淋巴結內有多個不規則、地圖狀至星狀（stellate）的壞死灶，中心為含核碎屑的化膿性壞死，周圍由柵欄狀排列（palisading）的類上皮組織球包圍；銀染色可見少數細小深色桿菌，符合貓抓病（Bartonella henselae）的化膿性肉芽腫性淋巴結炎。
features: Multiple irregular, serpiginous/stellate necrotizing granulomas replacing lymph node parenchyma
Central suppurative necrosis with granular eosinophilic debris, karyorrhectic nuclear dust and neutrophils
Rim of palisading epithelioid histiocytes with elongated, bean-shaped nuclei and pale cytoplasm
Outer zone of lymphocytes and fibrosis around the granulomas
Silver stain shows rare small dark rod-shaped bacilli within necrotic debris (limited resolution)
109.describe_en: Sections of an excised lymph node show extensive necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis with multiple coalescent, irregular to stellate necrotic foci. The necrotic centers contain granular debris with karyorrhectic nuclear dust and neutrophils, rimmed by palisading epithelioid histiocytes and an outer cuff of lymphocytes and fibrosis. No malignant cells or discrete multinucleated giant-cell-rich caseating granulomas are identified in these fields. A silver (Warthin-Starry-type) stain highlights rare small dark bacilli within the necrotic material, although resolution is limited. Findings are consistent with cat scratch disease (Bartonella henselae lymphadenitis) in the appropriate clinical and serologic context.

ddx.vs: Tuberculosis shows round caseating granulomas with Langhans giant cells and acid-fast bacilli rather than stellate suppurative microabscesses with silver-positive gram-negative bacilli.
These produce morphologically identical stellate suppurative granulomas, so separation relies on clinical exposure history, serology, culture or PCR.
Kikuchi shows paracortical necrosis with abundant karyorrhexis and crescentic histiocytes but characteristically lacks neutrophils and well-formed palisading granulomas.
Fungal infection shows yeast forms on GMS/PAS stains within necrotizing granulomas rather than small bacilli on Warthin-Starry stain.

captions: Edge of a necrotizing granuloma: central necrosis rimmed by histiocytes with a lymphoid/neutrophilic cluster
Necrotic zone bordered by palisading histiocytes beneath fibrosis and lymphocytes
Low power: multiple irregular, serpiginous/stellate necrotizing granulomas
High power: granular necrotic debris with nuclear dust rimmed by epithelioid histiocytes
Transition from suppurative necrosis to palisading epithelioid histiocytes
Palisading histiocytic rim around necrosis with overlying fibrosis and inflammatory cells
High power: epithelioid histiocytes with elongated bean-shaped nuclei adjacent to necrosis
Necrotic debris with wavy collagen fibers and degenerated nuclei
Silver stain: rare small dark rod-shaped bacilli in necrotic material (limited resolution)

exam.answer_en: Cat scratch disease (Bartonella henselae) — stellate suppurative necrotizing granulomas with palisading histiocytes; bacilli on Warthin-Starry silver stain
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍指星狀、地圖狀壞死灶，高倍指中心化膿與周圍柵欄狀組織球，問此型態稱為什麼（stellate microabscess／suppurative granuloma）與病原。
病程演變：早期濾泡增生與 monocytoid B 細胞增生，接著微膿瘍，最後融合成星狀壞死性肉芽腫。
確診多靠血清學或 PCR；Warthin-Starry 等銀染色敏感度有限，陰性不能排除。
臨床：多為兒童或年輕人，被貓抓咬後腋下、頸部單側淋巴結腫大，多自限；免疫不全者可為 bacillary angiomatosis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 化膿性肉芽腫也見於 tularemia、LGV、Yersinia 與非典型分枝桿菌；需靠部位（LGV 多腹股溝）、接觸史與 PCR/血清學區分。

quiz.q: 此淋巴結病變最可能的病原體是什麼？可用哪種組織染色找菌？

45.recognize_zh: 骨髓中成熟嗜中性球的核分葉多且濃縮、呈固縮（pyknotic）小球狀，由細絲相連，形成過度成熟的「髓滯留」（myelokathexis）；配合疣、低丙種球蛋白與反覆感染，指向 WHIM 症候群。
features: Mature neutrophils with hypersegmented nuclei composed of pyknotic, condensed, round lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments (myelokathexis)
Some neutrophils show cytoplasmic vacuolation and pale cytoplasm, suggesting apoptotic change
Aspirate is granulocyte-rich with a full spectrum of maturation and accumulation of hypermature forms
Core biopsy is hypercellular with a myeloid-predominant population of mature neutrophils with dense nuclei
Scattered lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, eosinophils and erythroid precursors; no increase in blasts
45.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears are cellular and granulocyte-predominant with preserved maturation and increased hypermature neutrophils whose nuclei are hypersegmented into small, dense, pyknotic lobes connected by fine filaments; some show cytoplasmic vacuolation. Blasts are not increased and eosinophils, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors are present. The core biopsy is hypercellular with granulocytic hyperplasia composed largely of mature neutrophils with condensed nuclei. In a patient with peripheral neutropenia, warts, hypogammaglobulinemia and recurrent infections, these findings of myelokathexis are consistent with WHIM syndrome (gain-of-function CXCR4 mutation).

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic neutrophils are large with more than five normally stained lobes and accompanying megaloblastic erythroid precursors, not small pyknotic lobes linked by filaments.
SCN shows maturation arrest at the promyelocyte/myelocyte stage with few mature neutrophils, the opposite of the marrow accumulation of hypermature neutrophils here.
MDS neutrophils are typically hypolobated (pseudo-Pelger) or hypogranular with other lineage dysplasia and clonal cytogenetics, rather than uniform hypersegmented pyknotic lobes.
Storage artifact produces single round pyknotic nuclear balls in peripheral blood, whereas myelokathexis is present in fresh marrow with multiple lobes still joined by strands.

captions: Smear with neutrophils showing condensed hypersegmented and vacuolated nuclei, lymphocytes and an eosinophil
Bone marrow aspirate: hypermature neutrophils with pyknotic lobes joined by thin filaments
Bone marrow aspirate: granulocyte-rich marrow with myelokathexis
Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E): hypercellular marrow with granulocytic predominance
Bone marrow core biopsy, high power: mature neutrophils with dense condensed nuclei

exam.answer_en: WHIM syndrome with myelokathexis — marrow full of hypermature neutrophils with pyknotic, hypersegmented lobes joined by thin filaments despite blood neutropenia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指核分成多個濃縮圓球、以細絲相連的嗜中性球問名稱——myelokathexis（骨髓滯留），並問為何周邊血卻是嗜中性球低下。
WHIM 四聯：Warts、Hypogammaglobulinemia、Infections、Myelokathexis；CXCR4 C 端截短之功能獲得突變，體染色體顯性。
機轉：CXCR4 訊號過強使嗜中性球滯留骨髓無法釋出並在骨髓凋亡。
治療：CXCR4 拮抗劑 mavorixafor 已獲核准用於 WHIM；plerixafor 亦可動員嗜中性球；另可用 G-CSF 與 IVIG。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為巨母紅血球性貧血或 MDS 的核過度分葉：後者核葉不呈固縮小球、常伴巨球性變化或其他系列發育不良；也需排除抹片延遲處理造成的凋亡假象。

quiz.q: 骨髓中核呈固縮多葉、以細絲相連的成熟嗜中性球堆積，稱為什麼？相關基因？

3565.recognize_zh: 視野中可見一顆大小接近紅血球的巨大血小板（左側），右側中性球胞質邊緣有一塊淡藍色的 Döhle 樣包涵體，血小板整體偏少；巨大血小板加上中性球藍色包涵體是 MYH9 相關疾病（May-Hegglin anomaly）的典型組合。
features: Giant platelet approaching red-cell size with central purple granulomere and pale hyalomere
Neutrophil with a faint pale blue, Döhle-like cytoplasmic inclusion at the cell periphery
Otherwise normally segmented neutrophil with fine granules
Few platelets overall (thrombocytopenia), with occasional normal-sized or large platelets
Normochromic red cells
3565.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a markedly enlarged platelet approaching the diameter of an adjacent red cell and a paucity of platelets overall. A segmented neutrophil contains a faint, pale blue, Döhle-like inclusion at the cytoplasmic periphery. Neutrophil granulation and segmentation are otherwise normal, and red cells are normochromic. The triad of macrothrombocytopenia with neutrophil Döhle-like inclusions is consistent with an MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly); immunofluorescence for non-muscle myosin heavy chain IIA aggregates or MYH9 sequencing confirms the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: ITP may show large platelets but lacks neutrophil inclusions and responds to immunosuppression, which should be avoided in MYH9-RD.
Bernard-Soulier shows giant platelets without neutrophil inclusions and has absent ristocetin-induced aggregation due to GPIb-IX-V deficiency.

ddx.dx: True Döhle bodies in infection or pregnancy
ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies accompany toxic granulation and vacuolation, without giant platelets or lifelong thrombocytopenia.
Gray platelet syndrome shows large, pale, agranular platelets without neutrophil inclusions.

exam.answer_en: May-Hegglin anomaly (MYH9-related disorder) — giant platelet with thrombocytopenia plus Döhle-like inclusion in a neutrophil
pearls_zh: 考法：考官同時指巨大血小板與中性球胞質邊緣的淡藍包涵體，問診斷與致病基因；答 MYH9-related disorder，MYH9 編碼 non-muscle myosin heavy chain IIA，體染色體顯性遺傳。
巨大血小板常被自動血球計數儀計為紅血球，導致血小板數被低估，應以抹片或人工計數確認。
MYH9-RD 為系統性疾病：可合併腎病變（蛋白尿）、感音性聽力喪失、早發性白內障與肝酵素升高，需長期追蹤腎功能與聽力（舊稱 Epstein、Fechtner、Sebastian syndrome）。
確診：周邊血中性球 NMMHC-IIA 免疫螢光染色可見異常聚集，或 MYH9 基因檢測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤診為 ITP 而接受類固醇、IVIG 甚至脾切除；鑑別點在於中性球 Döhle-like 包涵體與巨大血小板、長期穩定且有家族史；Bernard-Soulier 也有巨大血小板但無中性球包涵體。

quiz.q: 巨大血小板合併中性球藍色包涵體，致病基因為何？需追蹤哪些器官？
quiz.a: MYH9；腎臟（蛋白尿）、聽力、眼睛（白內障）

62765.recognize_zh: 左邊周邊血液（A）、右邊骨髓抹片（B）都可見中大型淋巴樣細胞，胞質深藍色並佈滿明顯空泡，外觀很像 Burkitt 淋巴瘤；但診斷為被套細胞淋巴瘤，必須靠 cyclin D1/SOX11 或 t(11;14) 確認，不能只看形態。
features: Medium to large lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Finely dispersed to moderately condensed chromatin with small nucleoli in some cells
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous discrete clear vacuoles
Panel A: circulating atypical cells in peripheral blood with normal-appearing red cells
Panel B: marrow aspirate largely replaced by the same vacuolated cells with few residual normal elements
62765.describe_en: Composite image shows peripheral blood (A) and bone marrow aspirate (B). Both contain a population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with round to mildly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate amounts of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous prominent vacuoles, closely mimicking Burkitt lymphoma cells. The marrow is extensively infiltrated with few residual hematopoietic precursors. Morphology alone cannot distinguish this from Burkitt lymphoma; cyclin D1 or SOX11 expression or t(11;14)(q13;q32) is required. In that context, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with unusual Burkitt-like morphology.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are CD10+, BCL2-negative, have MYC rearrangement with Ki-67 near 100%, and lack cyclin D1 and t(11;14).

ddx.dx: Blastoid or pleomorphic mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Blastoid MCL shares cyclin D1 positivity but usually has lymphoblast-like fine chromatin without prominent cytoplasmic vacuoles.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma can look Burkitt-like but is defined by MYC plus BCL2 rearrangements on FISH and is cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts may be vacuolated but have folded nuclei, gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules, and are NSE and CD64/CD14 positive rather than B-cell markers.
